༄༅/ /bsal nas dge ba sgrub pa ji snyed pa phar phyin drug ldan du spyod pas spyi dang bye brag go /mkhyen gsum dang sbyor bzhi dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa bstan la/ chos sku dang 'brel pa'i sgrub pa mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan / mkhyen gsum yul gyi sgo nas/ sbyor bzhi rgyu'i sgo nas bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de rnams dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa bstan la/ chos sku 'bras bu'i sgo nas bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa ma bstan pa yin no/ /rgyas bshad la bzhi las go cha'i sgrub pa ni/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bshad pa yin te/ 'di la gsum las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir sgrub pa bzhi po rnams kyi nang nas dang po go cha'i sgrub pa gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ go cha'i sgrub pa'i ngo bo de go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa nyid kyis so/ /sgrub pa bzhi'i sa mtshams ni/ spi dang bye brag gi sbo nas sgrab pa'i ngo bo bstan pa de ltar sgrab pa bzhi'i sa mtshams kyang rim pa ji lta ba bzhin sbyar na go cha'i sgrub pa ni tshogs lam nas yod de/ de nges 'byed cha mthun la ltos te mthong lam la barmed nas sbyor ba tshogs blame gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i brdeg nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'jug sgrub ni nges 'byed cha mthun nas yod de/ de tshogs lam la ltos te mthong lam la dngos su sbyor ba mos pa

spyod pa'i sa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs sgrub ni chos mchog chen po'i skad cig tha ma nas yod de/ tshogs sgrub dang po bco lnga ni nges 'byed cha mthun dang po gsum la ltobasdo rnes mthong lam la mngon sum du sbyor ba chos mchog chen pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / sa rab dga' dang mthong spang gnyen pa'i tshogs sgrub ni mthong lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid yin/sa lhag ma dgu dang sgom spong gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub ni sgom lam gyi ngo bo nyid kyi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung sgrub pa ni dag pa sa na yod de/ de khyad par gyi lam gyi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir / ya mtha' sgrub pa bzhi ka rgyun mtha' na yod do/ /gnyis pa so sor bshad pa ni/ go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig /go cha'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na/phar phyin drug gi go cha'i sgrub pa drug dang / drug po re re la yang drug drug gis go cha'i sgrub pa so drug go /de rnams gang na/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /gtso bor gyur pa'i go cha'i brtson 'gyus kyis gtso bor sbyin pa'i phar phyin phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len par byed pa/ de gang na/ sbyin pa gtong bar byed do/ /gang gi sa na byang sems chen pos so/ /ji ltar na :na pa'i

༄༅/ /phar phyin la spyod pa na chos dang zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa'i snyin pa smin par byed pa sbyin pa'i sbyin pa/ mi mthun phyogs kyis mi phigs pa'i cha nas sbyin pa'i go cha/ de bzhin du phyi ma rnams la yang mdzod / sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi sbyin pa'i go cha'i sgrub pa ni/ gang zhig 4 /gartso bor go cha'i brtson 'grus kyis gtso bor sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi sbyin pa nyams su len par byed pa/ de bzhin du phyi ma lnga la yang mdzod / sbyin pa'i phar phyin la spyod pa na nyan rang gis yid la byed pa spong ba sbyin pa'i tshul khrims kyi go cha dang / de la spyod pa na slong mo pa'i skye bo thams cad kyis mi snyan par smra ba nyid bzod pa sbyin pa'i bzod pa/de la spyod pa na dge ba gong nas gong du mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa bskyed pa spyin pa'i brtson 'grus/ de la spyod pa na theg pa gzhan nyan rang gi theg pa 'dod pa dang ma 'dres pa'i sems rtse gcig pa nyid kyis dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba sbyin pa'i bsam gtan/ de la spyod pa na sbyin par bya ba dang / sbyin pa po dang / len pa po ste 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi shes rab kyi phar phyin te/ phar phyin drug dang go cha drug gi sgo nas go rim bzhin du sbyin pa gtong ba byed do/ /phar phyin thams cad la sbyor mdzod/ phar phyin ni mos pa dang de kho na nyid yid byed gang rung gi sgo nas

'khor gsum du mi rtogs pa'o/ /de bzhin du tshul khrims srung bar byed/ bzod pa rdzogs par byed/ brtson 'grus rtsom par byed/ bsam gtan sgrub par byed/ shes rab sgom par byed do/ /spyir spyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab kyi phar phyin tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ don rnams gtong ba chos bzhi ldan/ spang pa'i sems pa/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba/ dge ba la spro ba/ sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed chos bzhi ldan/ chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs nyams par byed pa/ mi rtog ye shes dang ldan pa/ 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa/ sems can rnams skal ba dang 'tsham par theg pa gsum la sbyor bas sems can smin par byed pa gsum mo/ /gsum pa bsdus te bstan pa ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag so sor sbyin pa la sogs pa rnam pa drug tu bsdas pas na go cha'i sgrab pa gang yin pa de drag tshan drag gi sgo nas mdo ji bzhin byams pas bshad do/ /'o na drug tshan drug yod pas sum cu rtsa drug yin pa'i phyir/ go cha'i sgrub pa drug tu 'du ba mi 'thad do zhe na/ ra drug tshan drug gis ༄kyim cu rtsa drug yin rmede de lta rno'ang go cha'i sgrub pa drug tu ma 'dus pa'i skyon med de/ 'di ltar shes bya chos can/ go cha'i sgrub pa drug tu 'dus te/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin drug

༄༅/ /chos sbyin par mthun/ sbyin pa'i go cha drug sbyin pa'i go char mthun pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gzhan phar phyin lnga yang ngo / /gnyis pa 'jug sgrub ni/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la gsum las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ go sgrub bshad nas de'i rjes su gnyis pa 'jug sgrub bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bstan pa de ltar rnam mkhyen yid byed dang ldan pas phar phyin rnams mtshan mar mi dmigs pa'i go cha bgos pa las rang 'bras theg chen la 'jug pa 'byung bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi chos mtha' dag yang dag par gnas pa ste mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bgrod par byed pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi bsam gtan dang / gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug mtha' dag mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bgrod par byed pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ sbyin sogs la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi spyin sogs phar phyin drug po mtha' dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /'phags lam la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen

gyi mthong lam sogs mtha' dag mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bgrod par byed pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus gtso bor gyur pa/ de'i yul lam ni theg chen gyi mthong lam dang / sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam dang /'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma zhi bas mi slob lam sa brgyad pa dang / khyad par gyi lam sa dgu pa dang bcu pa zhes 'bum pas gsungs/ a bhā yas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyis bskor ba'i mthong ba dang sgom pa dang khyad par dang / mi slob pa'i lam la/ mi slob pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te bgrod par bya bas na lam mo zhes gsungs pas/ sgom lam sa bdun pa man/ khyad par lam dag pas gsum/mi slob lam rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bzhed do/ /byams sogs la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi tshad med bzhi po mtha' dag mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yul tshad med bzhi la tshad med pa'i ngo bo/ sems can tshad med pa la dmigs pa'i brtse ba gang zhig /chos bzhi ldan/ chos bzhi ni mi mthun phyogs spong ba/ mi rtog ye shes dang ldan pa/ dmigs pa sems can dang chos dang dmigs pa med pa la 'jug pa/ byed las sems can smin par byed pa'o/ /dbye na/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo ni rim pa bzhin

༄༅/ /du / bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sems can tshad med pa bde ba dang phrad pa'i dang / sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i dang / bde ba dang mi bral ba'i dang / sems can tshad med pa la phan pa'i bsam pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtha' dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yul mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /'khor gsum rnam dag la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi 'khor gsum rnam dag mtha' dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yul 'khor gsum rnam dag ni dngos po thams cad las/ bya ba/ byed po gsum du mi dmigs pas na 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'o/ /ched du bya ba la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi sgom pa'i don gzhig pa'i ched du bya ba mtha' dag sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yul ched du bya ba chen po gsum la slob dpon bzhed do/ /mngon par shes pa la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg chen gyi mngon shes drug po mtha' deg sogs sngar bzhin no/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i tshul la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /rnam pa

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la dmigs te mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bgrod par byed pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'gyus gtso bor gyur pa ste rnam pa dgu'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul theg chen gyi chos dgu yod pas so/ /'jug yul theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ bgrod pa gang zhig /chen po bdun ldan/ chen po bdun ni/ jugasung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la dmigs pas dmigs pa chen po/ rang gzhan gyi don gnyis sgrub pas sgrub pa chen po/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bdag med gnyis rtogs pas ye shes chen po/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus brtsams pas rtsom pa chen po/ gzhan don du 'khor bar gnas kyang de'i skyon gyis mi gos pas thabs mkhas pa chen po/ stobs bcu sogs yang dag par 'grub pas yang dag par 'grub pa chen po/ yang dang yang du byang chub pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pas phrin las chen po'o/ /dbye na rgyu'i theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ bgrod par byed pa gang zhig /chen po bdun ldan/ 'bras bu'i theg chen gyi mtshan nyid/ chen po bdun ldan gang zhig /bgrod bya mthar thug /'dir bstan gyi theg chen dang po brgyad rgyu'i theg chen/ phyi ma 'bras bu'i theg chen yin no/ /gsum pa 'jug sgrub dgu'i go rim ni rtogs pa'i go rim mo/ /gsum pa tshogs sgrub la spyir bstan pa

༄༅/ /dang bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ brtse dang sbyin pa la sogs pa drag /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la bzhi las mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/'jug sgrub bstan nas de'i rjes su gsum pa tshogs sgrub bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bsten pa de ltar theg chen la 'jug pa byas pa la rang 'bras tshogs skye bas so/ /gnyis pa ngo bo ni/ khyad par bzhi ldan gang zhig /rang gi dngos 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chub chen po gang rung dngos su 'byin pa'i bya ba ni tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi dbye ngo rnam pa bcu bdun no/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan snying rje la sogs pa tshogs bcu bdun yod pa yin pas so/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun du 'byed pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ snying rje la sogs pa'i tshogs bcu bdun yod pas so / /de rnams gang zhe na/ sgrub par byed do/ /gang na theg chen gyi don byang chub chen po mtha' dag go /ji ltar na/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa sna ma lta bu'i tshul du'o / /gang gi sgo nas na/ snying rje la sogs pa rnams bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /gang gis na byang sems chen po rnams kyis so/ /des na/ brtse ba snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi

mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /snying rje chen po'i tshogs mi dmigs par nyams su blangs pa'i sgo nas rang gi dngos 'bras gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi byang chub chen po gang rung dngos su 'byin pa'i bya ba/ spyin pa dang la sogs pa tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims ngang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi tshogs mi dmigs par sogs 'dra/ zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong dang / zung du 'brel ba'i lam dang / thabs mkhas pa dang / ye shes dang / bsod nams dang / lam gyi tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /zhi gnas ting nge 'dzin dang / lhag mthong shes rab dang / thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i lam dang / sems bskyed dang /shes rab dang / bsngo ba gsum dang bcas pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang / ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams dang / mthong ba la sogs pa'i lam gyi tshogs mi dmigs par sogs 'dra/ gzungs kyi tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /gzungs kyi tshogs mi dmigs par sogs 'dra/ de'i yul gzungs kyi tshogs la/ gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ khong du chud pa'i

༄༅/ /chos rnams mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na/ tshig gi gzungs/ sogs pa don gyi gzungs/ bzod pa'i gzungs/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhi/ tshig gi gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ don gyi gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi don mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de gnyis la dbye na/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i tshig dang don gyi gzungs/ tshe 'dir thos pa goms pa las byung ba'i tshig dang don gyi gzungs/ ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i tshig dang don gyi gzungs gsum/ dang po gnyis chung ngu yin la/ gsum pa chen po yin no/ /chen po la yang sa la ma zhugs pa tshogs sbyor ba'i ni chung ngu / sa la zhugs pa sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar 'bring po/ sa brgyad pa yan chad chen po yin no/ /bzod pa'i gzungs kyi mtshan nyid / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa la bzod pa mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ gsang sngags kyi yi ge rnams ji ltar

'dod pa bzhin byin gyis rlob par nus pa'i stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi ye shes dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sa mtshams dang po gnyis dbye bas shes la/ gsum pa theg chen gyi drod nas yod / bzhi pa sa dang po nas yod do/ /sa'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /sa'i tshogs mi dmigs par sogs 'dra/ de'i yul sa bcu ni 'og nas 'chad do/ /gnyen po tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/gang zhig /gnyen po'i tshogs ma dmigs par sogs 'dra/ gsum pa tshogs su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i snying rje la sogs pa bcu bdun po 'di chos can/ tshogs yin te/ khyod kyis yang dag par 'grub pa'i ngo bo byang chub chen po 'byin par byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa go rim ni/ snying rje nas/ gnyen po'i tshogs kyi bar bcu bdun po la la don gyi rim pa/ la la bshad pa'i rim pa'i sgo nas bstan pa 'di ni tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i rim pa yin par rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyis shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum las/ ye shes kyi tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa la/ yul can ye shes kyi tshogs dang / yul stong nyid nyi shu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshogs sgrub bcu bdun yod la de la de'i nang nas ye shes kyi tshogs bye brag tu 'chad pa la/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dbye gzhi/

༄༅/ /dbye ngo nang stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes nas gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bar rnam pa nyi shu'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul stong nyi shu yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /ye shes tshogs kyi sa mtshams ni/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam du stong nyid nyi shu po thos bsam gyi sgo nas rtogs/ de'i sbyor lam du sgom byung gsal snang dang bcas pas rtogs/ mthong sgom mi slob lam du mngon sum du rtogs pas/rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rnal ma ni mthong lam nas yod do/ /ngag don/ theg chen mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi nang stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes chos can/ tshogs yin te/ rang 'bras byang chub chen po 'byin par byed pa'i phyir dang des 'gre'o/ /shes bya chos can/ ye shes kyi tshogs la nyi shur 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ yul stong nyid nyi shu yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos can nyi shu la zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir/ stong nyid nyi shu gsungs na/ chos can nyi shu ni gang / stong nyid nyi shu'i ngo bo ni ci zhe na/ chos can nyi shu dang / stong nyid nyi shu po ye shes kyi tshogs 'chad pa'i skabs su 'dir tshigs su bcad nas smras pa/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched drug ni nang gi chos yin la/ de de kho nar skye 'gag med pa'i phyir de de kho nar rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni nang stong pa nyid yin no/ /ngag don ni/ mig sogs nang gi

dbang po drug chos can/ de kho nar rang gi ngo pos stong pa yin te/ de kho nar skye 'gag med pa'i phyir/ des 'gre'o/ /gzugs sogs yul drug ni phyi'i chos yin la/ de de kho nar skye 'gag dang bral ba'i phyir / de de kho nar rang gi ngo pos stong pa ni phyi stong pa nyid yin no/ /nang gi skye mched drug dang ni phyi nang gnyis ga'i chos yin/ de de kho nar sogs 'dra/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa ni stong pa nyid yin la / de de kho nar sogs 'dra/ de la stong pa'i dngos por zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu ni sems can dang snod kyi 'jig rten ma lus pa la khyab cing / tshad dang mu med pas chen po yin la sogs 'dra/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni dgos pa mchog yin pas don dam pa yin la sogs nas 'dra/ khams gsum ni/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pas 'dus byas yin la sogs nas 'dra/de las cig shos skye 'jig dang bral ba ni 'dus ma byas yin la sogs nas 'dra/ gang la mtha' med pa ni mtha' las 'das pa yin la sogs nas 'dra/ 'khor ba spyi tsam pa ni dang po dang tha ma min pas thog ma dang tha ma med pa yin la sogs nas 'dra/ dge phyogs spangs pa dang btang ba med pa ni dor ba med pa yin la sogs 'dra/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo spros bral ni 'phags pa rnams kyis ma byas pa'i ngo bo yin pas rang

༄༅/ /bzhin yin la sogs 'dra/ chos kun ni phung po lnga dang skye mched bcu gnyis sogs yin la de kho nar skye 'gag dang bral ba'i phyir/ de de kho nar rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin no/ /dang por skye ba/ sogs pa mthar 'jig pa/ 'dus byas spyi'i mtshan nyid gzugs kyi mtshan nyid gzugs su rung ba nas/ rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon sum du rtogs pa rnams ni rang gi mtshan nyid yin la sogs nas 'dra/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gsum po ni phan tshun gcig la gcig mi dmigs pas mi dmigs pa yin la sogs nas 'dra/ rgyu rkyen ldan pa las byung ba'i chos rnams ni rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ bden pa'i dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de de kho nar skye 'gag dang bral ba'i phyir/ de de kho nar rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin no/ /phung po lnga ni dngos po med pa las cig shos dngos po yin la sogs nas 'dra/ 'dus ma byas nam mkha' la sogs pa 'dus ma byas rnams ni dngos po med pa yin la nas 'dra/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i shes pas ma byas pa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ rang gi ngo bo yin la sogs 'dra/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid byed pa po gzhan gyis stong pa ni tshu rol mthong ba las gzhan pha

rol gzigs pa'i spyod yul yin pas gzhan gyi ngo bo yin la/ de de kho nar skye 'gag dang bral ba'i phyir/ de de kho nar rang gi ngo bos stong pa ni gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid yin no/ /mdor na/ shes bya chos can / stong nyid nyi shur dbyer rung ste/ nang gi chos nas gzhan gyi ngo bo'i bar chos can nyi shu po de de kho nar rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sa'i tshogs la gnyis las/ sbyi'i mtshams sbyar ni/byams mgon chos can/ nyid kyis sa'i tshogs la bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa gsum gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa gang dang gang gi yongs sbyong gi chos gang yin pa de bstan pa'i phyir du nyid kyis de la de gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sa'i tshogs dngos la/ rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyong / 'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la dgu las/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bshad pa ni/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ yongs sbyong dgu'i nang nas dang por sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa dang por sbyin pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ sngar ma byung ba'i chos nyid rtogs pa'i dga' ba chen po skyes pas na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba 'thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /

༄༅/ /gang la brten nas na/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong bcu po kho na yis so/ /bcur nges par ci shes she na/ shes bya chos can/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bcur nges pa yin te/ sa dang po'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad du bskyed par bya ba la yongs sbyong bcu dgos shing / de bas mang mi dgos nyung na mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bcu po gang zhe na/ sems bskyed pa ji lta ba bzhin byang chub kyi gzhi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rang don yid byed kyi gya gyu med pa'i bsam pa dang / rang gi dgos pa chos sku dang / gzhan gyi dgos pa gzugs sku thob pa la phan pa theg chen gyi ye shes tshol ba dang / sems can thams cad la sems rtse gcig pa'i tshad med bzhi sgrub pa dang / gzhan don du zas nor sogs bdog pa thams cad chags pa med par yongs su gtong ba dang / rnam mkhyen la bskul ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten nas mgu bar byed pa dang / de la theg pa gsum du gtogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi dmigs pa 'dod pa dang / khyim na gnas pa la mngon par mi dga' bar rtag tu bar chad kyi chos las nges par 'byung ba'i sems nyid dang / gzhan don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku 'dod pas de la dga' zhing de'i ched du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsngo ba dang / thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i dam

pa'i chos ston pa dang / bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas thog mar dge /dngos gzhi mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pas bar du dge /sems can thams cad dang thun mo nga du byas nas dge ba bla med byang chub tu bsngo bas tha mar dge ba'o/ /gzhan don la mi slu ba'i rgyu bden pa'i tshig smra ba nyid do/ /ngag don/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po chos can/ sems bskyed pa ji lta ba bzhin byang chub kyi gzhi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la gya gyu med pa'i bsam pa de mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas sbyangs pa la dgos pa yod de/ de de'i sgo nas sbyangs pas sa dang po'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par 'thob pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma rnams rigs 'gre'o/ /sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam brgyad kyis/ /sa ni gnyis pa yang dag 'thob/ /tshul khrims byas pa gzo dang bzod/ /nas 'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya bas bshad pa ni/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa dang po'i yongs sbyong bstan nas/ de'i rjes su sa gnyis pa'i yongs stong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa gnyis par tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri ma med pas nas gnyis pa dri ma ca

༄tsho/ /med pa 'thob pa yin no/ /gang la brten nas na/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong brgyad kyis so/ /brgyad ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong brgyad du nges te/ sa gnyis pa'i yon tan rdzogs par bskyed pa la yongs sbyong brgyad dgos shing de bas mang mi dgos/ nyung na mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ brgyad po gang zhe na/ 'chal ba'i tshul khrims gzhi dang bcas pa spong ba'i sems pa ni tshul khrims yin la/ dbye na/ dge ba mtha' dag sgrub par sems pa dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can tham sa cad kyi don sgrub par sems pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ mi dge ba mtha' dag spong bar sems pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / gzhan gyis rang la phan pa cung zad cig byas pa dran pas mi brnyas par drin du gzo ba dang / gzhan gyis rang la gnod pa byas ba dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang / chos zab mo la bzod pa dang / sbyin sogs dge ba'i chos sgrub pa la 'gyod pa med pas rab tu dga' ba dang / byis pa'i skye bo thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba dang mi 'bral bar bsam pa byis pa'i skye bo thams cad la snying brtse ba byams pa dang / mkhan slob sogs 'dud 'os thams cad la bkur ste byed pa 'dud pa dang / bla ma dge ba'i bshes

gnyen la gus shing des bstan pa'i dam pa'i chos nyan cing sgrub pa dang / sems can smin pa'i phyir du sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug la brtson zhing spro ba'o/ /ngag don/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ tshul khrims gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas sbyangs pa la dgos pa yod de/ de de'i sgo nas sbyangs pas sa gnyis pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par thob pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma rnams 'gre /sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam lnga yis/ /sa ni gsum pa yang dag 'thob/ /thos pas mi ngoms nyid dang ni/ /nas/ rlom med bdag nyid de rnam lnga/ /'di dag rang bzhin mi dmigs pas/ /yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bshad pa ni/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gnyis pa'i yongs stong bshad nas de'i 'og tu sa tshogasum pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa gsum par bzod pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ de kho na nyid mthong ba'i chos kyi snang ba chen po byed pas na sa gsum pa 'od byed pa 'thob pa yin no/ /gang la brten nas na/ rang gi shes rab sbyong ba phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams las dam pa'i chos thos shing nyan pas ngoms mi shes pa dang / rnyed bkur sogs zang zing

༄7/ /la mi lta ba'i sems kyis gdul bya la dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pa gzhan gyi shes rab sbyong ba dang / rang nyid ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas pa'i zhing rten snod dang brten pa sems can kun tu sbyong ba'i phyir du dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing der bsngo ba dang / phan btags pa'i sems can rnams de dang mi mthun pa phan lan du gnod pa skyel ba sogs 'khor ba'i nyes pa mthong nas gzhan don la mi skyo bar sems can gyi don lhag par byed pa dang / rang la ltos nas mi dge ba'i chos mi byed pa nyan rang gi sems spong ba ngo tsha shes pa dang / gzhan la ltos nas nyan rang gi sems spong ba khrel yod pa rnam sa la mchog tu 'dzin cing rlom pa med pa dang lnga po ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa la brten nas so/ /lnga ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong lngar nges te/ sa gsum pa'i yon tan rdzogs par skyed pa la yongs spyong lngar dgos shing / de bas mang mi dgos/ /nyung na mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ sa gsum pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ dam pa'i chos nyan pas ngoms mi shes pa de mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas sbyangs pa la dgos pa yod de/ de de'i sgo nas sbyangs pas sa gsum pa'i yon tan rdzogs par 'thob pa'i phyir/ des 'gre'o/ /sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu

yis / /nas/ /yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bshad pa ni/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong bstan nas de'i rjes su sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun gyi mes sgrib gnyis kyi bud shing sreg pa'i 'od 'phro bas na sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba 'thob pa yin no/ /gang la brten nas na/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong bcu yis so/ /bcu ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong bcur nges te/ rtags rigs 'gre'o/ /bcu po gang zhe na/ nyan rang gi sa yid la byed pas dben pa'i nags te dgon par gnas pa dang / sngar rnyed pa ma thob pa la thob par mngon par 'dod pa med pa 'dod pa chung ba dang / rnyed pa thob pa la de bas lhag pa'i rnyed pa don du gnyer ba med pa chog shes pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis yang dag par sdom zhing bsten pa dang / bcu gnyis ni/zas bzang po la chags pa'i gnyen por bsod snyoms pa dang / la sogs pa yang yang za ba la chags pa'i gnyen por stan gcig pa dang / yang yang len pa la chags pa'i gnyen por phyis mi len pa ste zas kyi dbang

༄༅/ /du byas pa gsum/ gos bzang po la chags pa'i gnyen por phyag dar khrod pa/ 'jam po la chags pa'i gnyen por phying pa pa/ mang po la chags pa'i gnyen por chos gos gsum pa ste/ gos kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ gnas 'du 'dzi can dang / steng g.yogs pa dang / phyogs kun nas bskor ba can dang / gnas 'byor pa can la chags pa'i gnyen por rim pa bzhin du dgon pa pa dang / bla gab med pa dang / shing drung pa dang / dur khrod pa ste gnas kyi dbang du byas pa bzhi/ nyal ba dang bsnyes pa sogs la chags pa'i gnyen por tsog pu pa dang gnas yang yang spo ba la chags pa'i gnyen por gzhi ji bzhin pa ste spyod lam gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis te'o/ /gzhan don du bslab pa gsum blangs pa srog dang lus dang gnyen la sogs pa'i phyir yang mi gtong bar bsrung ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan gzugs mdzes la sogs la nyes dmigs su lta ba'i sgo nas smod pa dang / gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par theg pa gsum gyi mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol bar byed pa dang / gzhan don du phyi nang gi bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong ba dang / gzhan don du dge ba'i chos rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la sems mi zhum pa dang / gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad la mtshan ma cir yang mi lta ba'o/ /ngag don rigs 'gre/

sa lnga pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam bcu yis/ /nas/ /yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bshad pa ni/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong bstan nas/ de'i rjes su sa lnga pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa lnga par bsam gtan gyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ sems can smin par byed pa dang sems can gyi log sgrub kyis rang gi sems nyon mongs pa can du mi 'gyur ba ste bya dka' ba gnyis byed pas na sa lnga la sbyang dka' ba 'thob pa yin no/ /gang la brten nas na/ spang bya bcu spyong zhing ldog pa gnyen po'i chos shugs la 'phangs pa'i yongs sbyong bcu ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa yis so/ /bcu ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can nas/ rigs 'gre'o/ /spang gnyen bcu po gang zhe na/ rnyed bkur la sogs pa'i don du rab tu byung ba dge slong ma dang / khyim la sogs dang 'dris shing 'grogs pa'i gnyen por dge slong ma dang se gol gtogs pa tsam yang lhan cig mi gnas pa dang / khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba byed pa dang / ser snas gzhan la dad pa can gyi khyim la 'khren cing nye bar mi ston pa'i gnyen por bde ba la ser sna'i sems mi skyed pa dang / phyi'i 'du 'dzi skye bo

༄༅/ /mang po 'du ba'i bongal sog rme pa'iganasadang nang gi 'du 'dzi nyan rang gi sa yid la byed par gnas pa'i gnyen por phyi nang gi dgone par gnas pa dang / rnyed sogs kyis bdag la bstod cing bsngags pa'i gnyen por nang gi chos yang dag par mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / phrag dog gis gzhan la brnyas pa'i gnyen por phyi'i chos yang dag par ma dmigs par rtogs pa dang / mi dge ba'i las kyi lam bcu'i bag chags kyi gnyen por mi dge ba bcu gzhi dang bcas pa yang dag par mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / thos pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa'i sgo nas rlom pas khengs shing 'dud 'os gzhan la mi ladud pa'i gnyen por khengs pa'i gzhi ma dmigs par yang dag par rtogs pa dang / dge mi dge phyin ci log tu mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por blang dor gyi gnas lugs yang dag par rtogs pa dang / log lta la sogs pa blo gros ngan pa'i gnyen por chos rnams kyi gnas lugs yang dag par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa thams cad la bzod cing phyogs par byed pa'i gnyen por nyon mongs pa gzhi dang bcas pa yang dag par ma dmigs par rtogs pa'o/ /ngag don rigs 'gre'o/ /sa drug pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba bcu gnyis kyis/ /nas/ yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes

bya bas gsungs pa la/ mtshamasaldir ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa lnga pa'i yongs sbyong bstan nas de'i rjes su sa drug pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa drug par sher phyin la gtso bornya nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa / yum la brten nas 'khor 'das gnyis rang bzhin ma dmigs par mngon du gyur bas na sa drug pa mngon du gyur ba kun 'thob pa yin no/ /gang la brten nas na/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong bcu gnyis kyis so/ /bcu gnyis ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ chos rtags rigs 'gre/ bcu gnyis po gang zhe na/ gnas skabs kyi phar phyin drug rdzogs pa dang de rdzogs pas spang bya drug spangs pa ste/ de yang rang don yid byed kyis dben pa'i sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi phar phyin rdzogs pas slob ma nyan thos dang bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la dga' zhing 'dod pa'i sems spangs pa dang / chos zab mo la nges par rtogs pa'i bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pas rang bzhin spros bral la skrag pa'i sems spangs pa dang / bdog pa thams cad gtong ba la spro dga' dang bcas pa'i brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin rdzogs pas sbyin pa la dang por 'jug pa'i gegs slong ba po'i skye bos bslangs na ser snas zil gyis non nas zhum pa'i sems spangs pa dang / gzhan don la rtse gcig

༄༅/ /tu gnas pa'i bsam gtan gyi phar phyin rdzogs pa'i spyin pa'i phar phyin 'grub pa'i gegs nor sogs bdog pa thams cad rang gi ngang gis gtong bar zhugs pa la mi dga' ba'i sems spangs pa dang /lam sher phyin rdzogs pas rang nyid longs spyod kyis bkren yang slong ba po'i skye bo la sbyin pa spong ba'i sems spangs pa'o/ /ngag don rigs 'gre/ sa bdun pa'i yongs spyod la spang bya spangs pa dang / gnyen po rdzogs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ yongs su sbyong ba nyi shu yis/ /sa ni bdun pa yang dag thob/ /bdag dang sems can 'dzin pa dang / /nas/ yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya bas gsungs pa la/mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa drug pa'i yongs sbyong bstan nas de'i rjes su sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bdun par thabs mkhas pa'i phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs pa rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong nyi shus bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang 'brel bas mtshan mar 'dzin pa las ring du song bas na sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i yon tan kun 'thob pa yin no/ /nyi shu ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ chos rtags rigs 'gre/ nyi shu po gang zhe na/ nga rgyal bskyed pas na bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / zhum pa'i bdag

nyid can yin pas na sems can dang / skal ba mnyam pa'i rigs yongs su rdzogs kyi bar du gnas pas na srog dang / 'gro ba rnams su yang yang gnas pas na gang zag dang / gzhan don chad pa dang / rang don 'gyur med rtag pa dang / 'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang / mthar thug theg pa gsum gyi rgyu rigs tha dad du 'dzin pa dang / phung po skye 'jig byed par 'dzin pa dang / khams nyer spyod 'dzin par zhen pa dang / phyi nang gi skye mched tha dad du 'dzin pa dang / dang por khams gsum po la gnas pa ste mngon par zhen pa dang / phyis rgyun du mngon par zhen pa chags pa dang / rnam mkhyen mi 'thob snyam du sems kun tu zhum pa dang / gzugs sku la sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la chos dkon mchog dang / skyes bu zung bzhi la dge 'dun dkon mchog dang /'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen po la tshul khrims su lta bar mngon par zhen pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rtsod pa the tshom za ba dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang 'gal bar brjod pa bden par 'dzin pa ste/dang po bco brgyad bye brag /tha ma gnyis spyi ste/ nyes pa nyi shu spangs pa nyes pa las zlog pa gnyen po'i chos spang bya dngos su bstan pa'i shugs kyis 'phangs pa nyi shu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spang bya'i shugs kyis

༄/ /'phangs pa'i gnyen po nyi shu gang zhe na/gespang bya dngos su bzhe pa 'i shugs kyis 'a4lo kho tsho chos nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang / zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dang sems can dang srog tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por rnam par thar pa'i sgo ngo bos stong pa nyid dang / rgyus mas ma med pa dang / 'bras bu la smon pa med pa yang dag par shes rnga dang / gang zag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gsad bya dang gsod pa po dang gsod pa la 'khor gsum mi dmigs par rtogs pa dang / gzhan don chad par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por skye bo sdug bsngal thams cad la dmigs nas sdug bsngal las skyob par spro ba'i snying rje dang / rang don 'gyur med rtag par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por rang gi rtogs pa la bden par dmigs shing rlom pa med pa dang /'khor 'das la blang dor gyi mas mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang / mthar thug theg pa gsum gyi rgyu rigs tha dad du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por theg pa gsum gyi rigs mthar thug theg pa chen po'i rigs gcig tu rtogs pa dang / phung po skye 'jig byed par 'dzin pa'i gnyen por ming gzugs gdod ma nas mi skye bar yongs su shes pa dang /

khams nyer spyod 'dzin par zhen pa'i gnyen por chos zab mo rang bzhin spros bral la nges par rtogs pa'i bzod pa shes shing khong du chud pa dang / phyi nang gi skye mched tha dad du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por phyi shes bya nang skye mched kyi chos rnams thams cad theg pa chen po'i thabs rang bzhin spros bral gyi sgo nas dbyer med par rab tu ston pa dang / dang po khams gsum po la mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por mngon zhen gyi rtog pa thams cad gcod pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / khams gsum po la phyis rgyun du mngon par zhen pa'i chags pa'i gnyen por mtshan mar 'du shes shing 'dzin pa'i rtog pa spong ba dang / rnam mkhyen mi 'thob snyam du sems kun tu zhus pa'i gnyen por lta ba lnga'i gnas ngan len dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i gnas ngan len spong ba dang / rnam mkhyen la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas nges par sems shing sgom pa dang / lta ba lnga gang zhe na/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ni/ nyer len gyi phung po lnga la dmigs nas bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i shes bzhin ma yin pa/ sogs pa mthar 'dzin pa'i lta ba ni/ nyer len gyi phung po lnga la rtag pa'am chad par lta ba'i shes bzhin ma yin pa/ log par lta ba'i lta ba ni/ shes bya'i chos rnams la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa'i shes bzhin ma yin pa/ lta ba la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba ni/

༄༅/ /lta ba'i gnas nyer len gyi phung po lnga la mchog dang / gtso bo dang / dam par yang dag par lta ba'i shes bzhin ma yin pa/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i lta ba ni/ tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs kyi gnas nyer len gyi phung po lnga la dag pa dang grol ba dang / nges 'byin gyi lam du lta ba'i shes bzhin ma yin pa/ gzugs sku la sangs rgyas dkon mchog tu lta ba'i mngon zhen gyi gnyen por stong nyid rtogs pa'i lhag mthong shes rab dang / gzhan don byed pa'i thabs la mkhas par byed pa dang / gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la chos dkon mchog tu lta ba'i mngon zhen gyi gnyen por mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sems dul zhing nye bar zhi ba dang / skyes bu zung bzhi la dge 'dun dkon mchog tu lta ba'i mngon zhen gyi gnyen por gzugs la sogs pa chos thams cad la thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i ye shes dang /'chal ba'i tshul khrims kyi gnyen po tshul khrims su lta ba'i mngon zhen gyi gnyen po chos gang la yang mngon par chags shing zhen pa'i gnas ma yin par rtogs pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la the tshom za ba'i gnyen por rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dus mnyam du ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig na gnas bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan thams cad du 'gro ba dang / rang bzhin stong nyid de dang 'gal ba bden 'dzin gyi gnyen por

zhing khams dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du gdul bya dang mthun par bdag gi ngo bo lus rab tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i yongs sbyong nyi shu po 'dis kyang snga ma sa dang po'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin du sa bdun pa 'thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /ngag don rigs 'gre'o/ /sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba rnam brgyad kyis/ /sa ni brgyad pa yang dag 'thob/ /nas/ yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya bas bshad pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong bshad nas/ de'i rjes su sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa brgyad par smon lam gyi phar phyin la gtso bor stod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong brgyad kyis mtshan ma la rtsol ba dang / mtshan ma med pa la rtsol ba'i 'du shes gnyis kyis mi g.yo bas na sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba 'thob pa yin no/ /brgyad ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ chos rtags rigs 'gre /brgyad gang zhe na/ sems rtse gcig gis sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa chags pa yod med la sogs ji lta ba bzhin shes pa dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang mi snang du byed pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pas rtse ba dang /

༄7/ /rang nyid ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas pa'i zhing rten snod kyi 'jig rten gser dngul la sogs pa bzang po'i ngo bor sgrub cing bsgyur ba dang / rnam pa thams cad du chos sku yongs su brtags te thob par bya ba'i phyir du sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku bsten te mnyes par byed pa dang / sems can gyi dbang po shes pa'i lha'i mig bskyed pa dang / rang nyid ma 'ongs pa na 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing brten pa sems can rnams nyes pa med cing yon tan dang ldan par yongs su sbyong ba dang / ting nge 'dzin las ldang 'jug thams cad du sgyu ma lta bur gnas shing yang dang yang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi don 'grub par mthong na blo sngon du btang ba'i skye ba yongs su 'dzin pa ni bsam bzhin du skye ba len pa'o/ /ngag don rigs 'gre /sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyong ni/ yongs su sbyong ba bcu gnyis kyis/ /sa ni dgu pa yang dag 'thob/ /smon lam dag ni mtha' yas dang / /nas/ /yongs su sbyong bar shes par bya/ /zhes bya bas bshad pa la/ mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong bstan nas de'i rjes su sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyong bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa dgu pa stobs kyi phar phyin la gtso bor spyod pa nyid kyis so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i yongs sbyong bcu

gnyis kyis so so yang dag rig pa'i blo gros bzang po thob pas na sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros 'thob pa yin no/ /bcu gnyis ci dgos she na/ shes bya chos can/ sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyong bcu gnyis su nges te/sa dgu pa'i yon tan rdzogs par skyed pa la bcu gnyis dgos shing / de bas mang mi dgos/ nyung na mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ bcu gnyis po gang zhe na/ bsam pa ltar 'grub pa'i smon lam mtha' yas pa dang /lha la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi skad shes pa nges pa'i tshig so so yang dag par rig pa dang / rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i spobs pa chu bo chen po'itshorgyun ltar mi zad pa spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa dang / skye bo dam pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa bud med kyi skyon thams cad dang bral ba'i mi'i mngal du 'jug pa ni mngal du 'jug pa mchog dang / spyir rgyal rigs shing swā la chen po lta bu'am bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu la sogs par gnas pa ni rigs phun sum tshogs pa dang / bye brag tu nyi ma dang bu ram shing la sogs pa las skyes pa ni rus phun sum tshogs pa dang / pha ma dang legs par 'brel ba'i gnyen dam pa 'ba' zhig 'byung ba ni cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa dang / ji ltar bzhed pa bzhin sgrub pa'i rang dbang ba'i 'khor ni 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dang / skyes ma thag brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pas

no༅༅/ /mngon par bstod pa dang bcas te skye ba ni skye ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas/ srid gsum mi rtag rtswa rtse'i zil pa 'dra/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig gis bskul te khyim nas nges par 'byung ba ni nges 'byung phun sum tshogs pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba'i 'tshang rgya ba'i rten byang chub kyi shing thub pa'i a shwa tha dang / byams pa'i klu shing la sogs pa'i gnas byang chub kyi shing phun sum tshogs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi stobs bcu la sogs pa ngo bor gyur pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par byed pa ni yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ngag don/ sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ smon lam mtha' yas pa mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas sbyangs pa la dgos pa yod de/ de de'i sgo nas sbyangs pas sa dgu pa'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs par 'thob pa'i phyir/des phyi ma thams cad rigs 'gre'o/ /'bras bu sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sa dgu 'das nas ye shes ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ byams mgon chos can/nyid kyis gong du bstan pa de ltar rgyu sa dgu'i yongs sbyong bstan nas/ 'bras bu'i sa nyid du yongs sbyong ma bshad par sa bcu pa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyid kyis sa bcu par sa dgu pa man chad

kyi rtogs pa thams cad yon tan yar ldan du 'dus pa la dgongs nas de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyid kyis mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong rtsa tshig gis dngos su zin par ma bshad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyid kyis sa dgu pa man chad kyi yongs sbyong las rigs gzhan du gyur pa'i sa bcu pa'i yongs stong med pa la dgongs nas mngon rtogs rgyan 'dir sa bcu pa'i yongs sbyong rtsa tshig gis dngos su zin par ma bshad pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ sa bcu rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu pa yin te/ 'das sa sa dgu las yon tan yar ldan du thob cing 'das nas smon lam gyi mthus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'tshang rgya ba'i sbyor bar shes pa gang gis te sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi sar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ shes bya chos can / sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi sar brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sa bcu ba la byang chub sems dpa' rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang gzhan don byed tshul mnyam pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas gnyis kyi nang nas sangs rgyas kho nar brjod par bya'i/ stobs sogs ma rdzogs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni ma yin no zhes nyi khri las dngos shugs la don mthun du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'das sa sa dgu gang zhe na/

༄༅/ /nyan thos kyi sbyor lam stan gcig pa'i rtogs pa mtshan gzhi/ dman pa'i sa brgyad kyi nang nas rigs kyi sar mtshon/ gnas skabs nyan thos kyi myang 'das su rigs nges par nyan thos so skye'i rtogs pa / sogs pa rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bu'i rigs can ni drod nas/ tshogs spyod chen po ni bzod chen nas/ tshogs spyod chung ngu ni mthong lam nas nges pas khyab/ byang sems chen po drod nas rigs nges par khyab bo/ /'bras bu dang po rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu yin la/ de la zhugs pa nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i rtogs pa dang / nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dang / nyan thos kyi phyir 'ong 'bras gnas dang / nyan thos kyi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas dang / nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa mtshan gzhi/ rim pa bzhin du dman pa'i sa brgyad kyi nang nas brgyad pa'i dang / mthong ba'i dang / bsrabs pa'i dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sar mtshon/ rim pa bzhin du dgra bcom 'bras gnas nas bgrangs na grangs brgyad pa la bab pa'i nyan thos yi zhugs pa'i rtogs pa/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu dang po gang zhig /phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu dang yang 'gal/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu dang yang 'gal ba/ 'dod nyon drug pa spangs/ 'dod nyon dgu pa dang khams gong gi nyon mongs gcig kyang

spangs pa med pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi theg pa/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs/ srid nyon dgu pa spangs pa med pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi theg pa/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa ma go spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi theg pa'o/ /nyan thos kyi zhugs pa lhag ma gsum gyi rtogs pa mtshan gzhi/ dman pa'i sa brgyad kyi nang nas nyan thos kyi sar mtshon/ rigs can gsum gyi nang nas rang bzhin gyis dbang po rtul po'i theg pa/ dbye na gong du bstan pa drug go /'o na gong ma drug las logs su bgrang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chos can/ nyid kyis 'das sa sa dgu 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir nyan thos kyi sa gong ma drug las logs su bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshul te gnas skabs theg pa gsum rnam par gzhag par dgongs nas de lta bu'i skabs 'dir de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa mtshan gzhi/ dman pa'i sa brgyad kyi nang nas rang sangs rgyas kyi sar mtshon/ rten 'brel zab mo rtogs pa'i theg pa 'bring po'i rtogs pa'o/ /gong du bshad ma thag pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa dgu mtshan gzhi/ 'das sa sa dgu'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa'i sar mtshon/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyu'i sa yin pa ste de ltar sa dgu'o/ /shes byed rgyas par rin po che'i bang mdzod

༄༅/ /las shes par mdzod/ gsum pa gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub ni/ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rnams/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ byams mgon chos can / nyid kyis gnyen po'i tshogs la bar skabs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ nyid kyis de la de gsungs pas gnyen po'i tshogs de mthong lam sgom lam gnyis las logs na yod dam snyam pa'i dogs pa khegs pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi/ sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bzhi ste rnam par brgyad do/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mi mthun phyogs mthong spang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi/ sgom spang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi ste brgyad yod pa'i dbye bas so/ /tshogs sgrub brgyad po de ni mngon du bya ba'i chos yin pas mngon du bya'o/ /gang na gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub brgyad do/ /gang la brten nas na kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis ga'i rnam pa la brten nas so/ /ji ltar na kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i rnam pa la brten nas mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i rnam pa la brten nas sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub bo/ /dgos pa gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa brgyad nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du'o/ /

gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa brgyad du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzung rtog gnyis 'dzin rtog gnyis te bzhi po so sor mthong spang du gyur pa rnams mthong lam gyis spong / sgom spang du gyur pa rnams sgom lam gyis spong pas so/ /ngag don ni/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub chos can/ rnam pa brgyad du 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ mi mthun phyogs brgyad yod pa'i dbye bas der phye ba'i phyir/ chos can/ bangen gnyis kyi rnam pa la brten nas mngon du byas pa la dgos pa yod de/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgyad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du bden gnyis kyi rnam pa la brten nas mngon du bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa brgyad du phye ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi po so sor mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam gyis spong bas so/ /gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi po gang zhe na/ gzung rtog la dngos po tsam dang gnyen po'i rten can gyi gzung rtog gnyis/ 'dzin rtog la gang zag rdzas yod dang skyes bu btags yod du 'dzin pa'i rten can gyi 'dzin rtog gnyis te rgyas par bshad zin to/ /gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub gnas skabs gang na yod ce na/ mthong sgom gyi lam gnyis po kho na'i gnas skabs kyi khyad par mnyam bzhag bar chad med lam na yod do/ /bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa ni/ ched du bya dang mnyam nyid dang / /zhes bya

༄tsho/ /ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ tshogs sgrub bstan nas bzhi pa nges 'byung sgrub pa bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bstan pa de ltar tshogs gnyis bsags pas sngar spang bya'i g.yul las ma rgyal ba las phyis rgyal ba nges par 'byung bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ ched du bya ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa nas lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa'i bar nges 'byung brgyad po 'di ni nges 'byung sgrub pa yin par rjes 'jug gi gdul byas shes par bya'o/ /de rnams gang zhe na/ byang sems chen po rnams ni nges par 'byung sa brgyad du 'byung ba thams cad mi dmigs par chogs pa'i sgo nas nges par te gdon mi za bar 'byung bas na/ gang zhig /'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du gdon mi za bar 'byung ba'i bya ba ni nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnom pa brgyad yin no/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan nges par 'byung sa brgyad yod pa yin pas so/ /'byung sa brgyad las lhag pa'i chos gzhan yang yod pas sgrub pa brgyad du ma nges so zhe na/ shes bya chos can/ nges par 'byung sa brgyad las lhag pa'i chos gzhan yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nges 'byung sgrub pa brgyad du ma nges pa ma yin te/ nges par 'byung bar bya ba'i gzhi brgyad po de lta bu dag las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos

gzhan med pa'i phyir/ des na nges par 'byung sa brgyad du nges pas nges par 'byung byed brgyad du nges so/ /de rnams gang zhe na/ ched du bya ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /sngar bshad pa'i ched du bya ba chen po gsum mthar thug tu gdon mi za bar 'byin pa'i bya ba/ mnyam pa'i nyid kyi nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /chos thams cad rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa mthar thug tu gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ sems can gyi don gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /sems can gyi don rgya chen po byed pa'i phrin las mthar thug tu gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ 'bad pa med pa'i nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /mdzad pa lhun grub mthar thug tu gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chos can/ mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa yin te/ 'bad rtsol gyi mtshan ma med par byed pa thams cad byed pa nyid kyis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa'i nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba'i khyad par mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ thob pa'i nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /theg pa gsum gyi spangs rtogs thams cad yon tan yar ldan du rdzogs par thob par gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ rnam mkhyen gyi nges 'byung

༄༅/ /sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /sngar bshad pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gdon mi za sogs 'dra/ lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /rnam mkhyen de'i dngos rgyu khyad par gyi lam sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam du gdon mi za bar 'byin pa'i bya ba'o// //skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ mdor na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs dang po'i 'grel pa don gsal gyi snying po'i rgyan re zhig rdzogs so// //de ltar skabs dang pos 'bras bu rnam mkhyen 'khor bcas bstan nas/ da ni skabs gnyis pas rgyu lam shes 'khor bcas ston pa la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen bstan nas de'i rjes su lam shes bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob pa ni/ rgyu lam shes yongs su shes pa med na med pas so/ /gnyis pa la lam shes kyi yan lag dang / yan lag can gyi lam shes gnyis/ dang po la lam shes skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag /skye ba'i yul nges pa/ khyab pa/ rang bzhin/ byed las dang

lnga wadang po ni/ lam shes 'chad pa'i 'khor du lhags pa'i 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi rgyud la lam shes skye rung du bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir du de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis lam shes 'chad pa'i 'khor du lhags pa'i 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa'i zag bcas kyi dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin las byung ba'i 'od mog mog por dri ma can lta bu dang / gzi brjid med par mdzad pa ni chags sdang dang / zhum sems dang / nga rgyal mngon gyur pa bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la rtogs pa lam shes dngos su skye'o zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir mdzad do/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyiri skabs 'di'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs sku'i 'od kyi che ba ston pa'i mdos tshig zur gyis te shugs la lam shes skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag brjod pa yin no/ /ngag don/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por mdzad pa ni chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ nga rgyal mngon gyur ba bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la lam shes dngos su skye'o zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ skabs 'di'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs sku'i 'od kyi che ba ston pa'i mdos shugs la lam shes skye ba'i rten gyi gang zag brjod pa yin te/ de

༄tsho/ /bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs sku'i 'od kyis 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por mdzad pa ni nga rgyal mngon gyur pa bcom pa'i rgyud kho na la lam shes dngos su skye'o zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir mdzad pa yin pa de'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyu lam shes de chos can/ dngos su skye ba'i yul so sor nges pa yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa kho na'i rgyud la dngos su skye ba yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ byang sems chen por ma zad khams gsum la sems 'dod chags dang bral ba nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang / zhi bgrod phyogs gcig pa'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can slob pa rnams dang / de las cig shos phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du gnas skabs rgyu lam shes bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/skye bo sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba can yin te/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir ro/ /de mi 'thad de/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag mthar thug la ltos te nges don yin pa'i phyir zer na / rtags ma grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa gsum du rnam par bzhag pa ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin gyi nges don mtshan nyid pa ma yin no zhes mdo las don mthun du 'byung bas

so / /de la dgongs gzhi gnas skabs nyan rang du rigs nges pa yod pa la dgongs/ dgos pa rig can gsum drang ba'i don du/ dngos la gnod byed nyan rang gi rgyud la spangs rtogs mthar thug pa med pas gnod do/ /des na theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin no/ /ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang phyi rol pa'i rnal 'byor pas kyang 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du rgyu lam shes bsgom par bya ba yin pas khyab pa yin te/ sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug par 'gro ba can yin pa'i phyir te/ theg pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag ni mthar thug la ltos te drang don dgongs pa can yin gyi nges don mtshan nyid pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa rgyu lam shes chos can/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa ma yin pa de khyod kyi rang bzhin yin te/ khyod 'khor ba'i ji srid par sems can gyi don byed par zhugs pa'i slob lam yin pas so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin cing sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rjes bslangs te/ gzhan don du srid par skye ba len par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa gcig yin la/ de

༄༅/ /nyon mongs btags pa ba yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rang rgyud ldan gyi skyes bu khams gsum du sbyor bar mtshungs pas so/ /dgos pa byang sems chen pos sems can mi 'dor bar shes/dngos la gnod byed sems nye bar nyon mongs par byed pa ma yin pas so/ /de ltar blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pas der gzigs mdzod/ lnga pa ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa spangs pa ma yin pa'i rang bzhin can gyi lam shes chos can/ gzhan don byed pa'i las can yin te/ rdzogs smin ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed cing thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas sems can sngar 'khor du ma bsdus pa 'khor du sdud/ sngar ma smin pa smin par byed/ sngar ma grol bar grol bar byed pa yin pas so/ /shes bya chos can/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin bstan nas de'i 'og tu lam shes kyi byed las bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rang bzhin can gyi lam shes las de'i byed las 'byung ba'i phyir/ mdor na/ lam shes kyi yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ lam she dngos su skye ba'i yul rten gyi gang zag lam shes kyi rang bzhin dang lam shes kyi byed las gang rung du gyur pa'i chos/ gnyis pa la nyan thos kyi lam dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dang / byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes gsum/

dang po la shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang lam shes/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar lam shes kyi rten la sogs pa brjod nas nyan thos kyi lam dang de shes pa'i lam shes bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes skye ba'i rten las lam shes 'byung ba'i phyir/chos can/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su nyan thos kyi lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad rdzogs par bya dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su gang zag byang chub sems dpas nyan thos rnams kyi lam 'di shes par bya'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ 'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams ngo bo nyid mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas so/ /des na rnam mkhyen yid la byed bas bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas nyan thos kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes de / nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid yin no/ /mtshan gzhi ni byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes lta bu'o/ /shes bya nyan thos lam gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go

༄༅/ /skabs phye shul du gyur pa/ dbye na nyan thos kyi tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam dang lnga/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams gang zhe na/ mdo las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa drug gsungs pa de la/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa dang go rim bzhin du sbyar na/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la rnam pa bzhi ste/ skye zhing 'jig pas na mi rtag pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i zag pa dang bcas shing 'phags lam gyi mi mthun phyogs su gyur pas na sdug bsngal ba dang / don gzhan gyi bdag gis stong pas na stong pa'i mtshan nyid bdag med pa dang / ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag med pas na bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid zhi ba ste/ mdor na mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gnyis ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa dang ming don gnyis ka mthun pa'i phyir/ 'dir shes phyin gyi mdo nas gsungs pa'i bdag med dang zhi ba gnyis rnam grangs kyi rnam pa yin te/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i stong pa la 'dir bdag med pa'i ming gis bstan/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i bdag med la 'dir zhi ba'i ming gis bstan pas don gcig ming tha dad yin pa'i phyir/ ngag don/ sdug bsngal bden pa chos can/ shes bya yin te/ mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med zhi ba yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod mi rtag sogs su bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod der bstan pas khyod la rtag bde

sogs su 'dzin pa zlog pa'i phyir/ chos can/ mi rtag pa yin te/ skye zhing 'jig pa'i phyir/ des rigs 'gre'o/ /kun 'byung bden pa la rnam pa bzhi ste/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo ni nad lta bu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i kun 'byung ba dang rab skye dang / rkyen gyi ngo bo ni 'bras dang zug rngu dang sdig pa lta bu'i rnam pa yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun skyed byed yin pa'i phyir dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal rab tu drag tu skyed byed yin pa'i phyir dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal brgyud mar 'byung ba'i rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa chos can / spang bya yin te/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kun 'byung rab skye rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ nad dang / 'bras dang / zug rngu dang / sdig pa lta bu'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ mthong lam du bden pa mngon sum du mthong bas sdug kun la yid 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir mthong lam gyi spyor ba nges 'byed cha mthun la zhugs/ sgom lam du sdug kun gnyis la 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir/ sgom lam gyi sbyor ba mthong lam la zhugs/ mi slob lam du sdug kun gnyis 'gog par bya ba'i phyir/ mi slob lam gyi sbyor ba sgom lam la zhugs pa yin no zhes chos mngon pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i phyir/ sher phyin gyi mdo las sdug

༄༅/ /kun gnyis so so'i yid 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo pha rol gnyen po'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa dang / gnyen pos 'jig pa'i chos can gyi rnam pa gnyis dang / sdug kun gnyis so so'i 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo/ rang gi ngo bo skad cig tsam yang gnas pa med pas g.yo ba dang / 'jig rgyu don gzhan la ltos med du 'jig pas rab tu 'jig pa'i rnam pa gnyis dang / sdug kun gnyis so so'i 'gog par bya ba'i rnam pa'i ngo bo 'di phyi la gnod pa'i gnas su gyur pas na 'jigs pa dang / rgyud la nye ba tsam gyis sdug bsngal myong bar byed pas na nad 'go ba dang / phan bde'i nor 'phrog par byed pas na 'tshe ba'i rnam pa gsum ste/ rnam pa bdun po rnams gsungs so/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ sher phyin gyi mdo las pha rol dang 'jig pa'i chos can dang / g.yo ba dang / rab tu 'jig pa dang /'jigs pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'tshe ba'i rnam pa rnams gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sdug kun gnyis la yid 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bar bya ba dang / 'gog par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin no zhes chos mngon pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i phyir/ sdug kun gnyis chos can/ yid 'byung bar bya ba yin te/ pha rol gnyen po'i mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa dang / gnyen pos 'jig pa'i chos can yin

pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma gnyis rigs 'gre/ 'gog bden la rnam pa bdun te ma rig pa 'gog pa'i ngo bo/ yul can nyon mongs pas dben pas na yul bdag med pa'i rnam pa dang / sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bas na zhi pa'i rnam pa dang / bde zhing gtsang bas rgya nom pa'i rnam pa'i bdag nyid sdug bsngal dang mi gtsang bas dben pa dang / gtan du phan pa'i gnas su nges par 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid/ ji ltar nges par 'byung bar ni/ bdag dang bdag gi ba'i ngo bos stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan ma med pa dang / khams gsum la smon pa med pa dang / gang nges par 'byung ba ni/ slar 'khor bsgo mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam pa rnams so/ /'gog bden chos can/ mngon du bya ba yin te/ 'gog pa dang / zhi ba dang / gya nom pa dang / nges 'byung gi rnam pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ yang na/ 'gog bden gyi chos bdag med sogs bdun chos can/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ lam bden la rnam pa bzhi ste/ thar pa'i grong khyer du phyin par byed pas na lam dang / mi rigs pa nyon mongs kyi gnyen po byed pas na rigs pa dang / sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pas na sgrub pa dang / rtag pa'i gnas su mngon zhen med par 'gro bas na nges 'byin gyi rnam pa rnams so/ /lam

༄༅/ /bden chos can/ bsten bya yin te/ lam rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i lam brjod nas nges 'byen cha mthun bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ bden bzhi mngon sum du shes pa ni rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun thob pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ grol sde gnyis ltar na/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi lam las byang sems chen po'i nges 'byed cha mthun dmigs rnam kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ston to/ /ji ltar na/ byang sems chen po'i spyor lam drod dang / rtse mo dang / bzod pa dang / chos mchog ni rim pa bzhin du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas phung po lnga'i stong nyid kyi rang bzhin rnam dag rnams dbyer med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas dang / mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas dang / rtag sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu las brtsams nas thams cad la dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya ma yin pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas gzugs sogs la dmigs pas nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /slob dpon ltar na sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i nyan thos

chos can/ gzugs sogs kyi stong nyid rnams don dam par phan tshun tha dad med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun drod skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par khyod kyi stong nyid rnams phan tshun tha dad med de/ khyod don dam par rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog la gnas pa'i nyan thos chos can/ gzugs sogs bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs rtag sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / mdo las rgyas par bstan pa rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcu las brtsams nas/ chos thams cad la bden par mi dmigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas go rim bzhin du nges 'byed cha mthun rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ gzugs sogs chos can/ bden par ma dmigs pa yin te/ rtags snga ma drod bzhin no/ /chos can/ rtag sogs su dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas bya bkag pa yin te/ rtags snga ma de bzhin du'o/ /ji ltar bkag na/ gzugs rtag pa

༄tsho/ /yang ma yin/ mi rtag pa yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma yin/ sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis bkag go /shes bya chos can/ rab dga' la sogs pa'i chos rnams de kho nar gnas bya ma yin te/ gang gi phyir na sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos rnams de kho nar gnas byar ma gzigs pa'i phyir zhes bya ba tshad ma'i skyes bus ma dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs kyi 'thad pas grub bo/ /mdor na/ nyan thos kyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu tshogs lam rdzogs rjes kyi nyan thos so skye'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa/ dbye na/drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ rim pa bzhin/ gang zhig /mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi me skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa/ gang zhig /mi mthun phyogs kyis g.yo ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ gang zhig /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi g.yo ba'i nang nas chung ngu / gang zhig /'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa rnams kyi nang nas bzod pa las mchog tu gyur pa/ gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la khyad zhugs par bstan pa dang / khyad par can lam dngos dang / rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/

'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi mjug thog tu rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dngos 'chad par rigs so zhe na/ theg pa gsum rim gyis bgrod par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi mjug thog tu rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dngos brjod par rigs mod/ de lta na yang re zhig rang sangs rgyas kyi lam nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa nyid du sgrub byed rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bgrod tshul dang chos ston tshul bstan pa 'di chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ 0nyan thos kyi lam rnams las rang sangs rgyas de dag gi lam ji ltar khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gis na rang sangs rgyas de dag gi lam nyan thos kyi lam las gzhan yin snyam pa'i dogs pa bsu nas de bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ shugs bstan nyan thos kyi lam dman pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dngos bstan rang sangs rgyas kyi lam khyad par du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ nyan thos kyi lung las nyan thos 'dod khams pa srid pa tha ma pa rnams ni rang gis byang chub thob pa slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la nges par ltos dgos la / 'dod pa'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom pa rnams ni rang nyid chos nyan pa ngag tu brjod pa la ltos dgos par ma zad rang gi gdul bya gzhan dag kyang dge bcu sogs la 'jug par byed pa'i ched du chos ston

༄༅/ /pa yang ngag tu brjod pa dang bcas pa la nges par ltos dgos so zhes 'byung bas na/ de gnyis kyi rtogs pa ni rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa las dman no/ /ngag don/ nyan thos 'dod khams pa srid pa tha ma pa chos can/ khyod kyi rtogs pa de rang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa las dman te/ khyod kyis rang gis byang chub thob pa slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la nges par ltos dgos pa'i phyir / des gcig kyang rigs 'gre/ gnyis pa la lam bgrod tshul dang / chos ston tshul gyi sgo nas khyad zhugs par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa rnams ni sngon tshogs lam gyi dus su sde snod gsum gyi don la thos pa sbyangs te mkhas par byas pa dang / sogs pa slob dpon gzhan la ma ltos par rang gis thob pa'i shes rab kyis lam bgrod par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam mngon par 'dus byas pa'i mthus slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos par bdag nyid kyis thob pa'i lam gyis rang byung gi byang chub thob par 'gyur ba de yin pa'i phyir/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa de dag la yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas dang byang sems gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos

par rang byung gi byang chub 'thob po zhes bya ba ni/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las zab pa khyad zhugs pa gcig tu mngon par brjod pa yin no/ /des sngon 'bras bu ma thob pa dang /thob pa'i tshogs dang spyod pa gnyis la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /ngag don/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring srid pa tha ma pa chos can/ khyod kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa yin te/ khyod slob dpon gzhan gyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la ltos mi dgos par bdag nyid kyis thob pa'i lam gyis rang byung gi byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa la dngos dang rtsod pa spang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kyang gi sgras bstan te/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas de dag ni rang gi lam gyis thob pa'i ye she dang / sogs pa smon lam gyi mthus sgra med lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas gdul bya gzhan dge ba bcu dang snyin sogs la 'jug par byed pa de'i phyir/ des sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la brten nas de'i gdul byas de dag gi ye shes mi rtogs pa nyid ni bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam larmo zab pa khyad zhugs pa gnyis pa yin pa mngon par brjod do/ /ngag don/ bse ru lta bu'i rang sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi ye shes ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa

༄༅/ /yin te/ khyod kyis rang gi gdul bya la ye shes dang smon lam gyi mthus sgra med lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas gdul bya dge bcu sogs la 'jug par byed pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod kyis sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la brten nas khyod kyi gdul byas khyod kyi ye shes mi rtogs pa yin te/ khyod kyis rang gi gdul bya la sgra bcas kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ 'chad pa pos nyan pa po la sgrar brjod pa'i chos bstan pa'i sgo nas nyan pa po rnams kyis 'chad pa po'i shes pa'i rtsal rtogs par byed na 'chad pa pos nyan pa po la sgrar brjod pa'i chos bstan dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la rtsod pa ni/sgra med par chos ston pa 'gal lo zhe na/ lan ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ ji ltar sgra med par chos ston snyam pa'i dogs pa bsus nas de bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ slob ma gang dag gang zhig bden bzhi sogs don gang dang gang la rnam pa mi rtag sogs ji ltar ji ltar nyan par 'dod pa de dang de'i rnam par shes pa la bden bzhi la sogs pa'i don de dang de rang sangs rgyas kyi ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med kyang smon lam dang

ye shes kyi mthus lus kyi sgo nas bden bzhi la sogs pa'i chos bstan pas ji ltar shes par 'dod pa'i rnam pa de dang de kho na ltar snang bar 'gyur bas sgra med par chos ston pa yod pas 'gal ba'i skyon med do/ /dper na byang chub sems dpa' gcig gis 'di ltar bdag sangs rgyas nas brjod pa med par chos ston par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de sangs rgyas pa na smon lam gyi mthus sgra med par chos ston pa de bas na chos ston tshul sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ rang sangs rgyas nyid kyi gnas skabs na yang de bzhin no/ /ngag don/ rang sangs rgyas chos can/ sgra med par chos ston pa yod de/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med kyang lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pas rang gis gdul byas ji ltar nyan par 'dod pa de kho na ltar de'i rnam par shes pa la snang bas so/ /chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra med de/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ma brtags ma dpyad par yang tshig tu mi smra/ brtags shing dpyad nas kyang tshig tu mi smra bas so/ /chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe ma brtags ma dpyad par tshig tu mi smra ba yin te/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe tshig tu smra na brtags dpyad bya dgos pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod kyis chos ston pa'i tshe brtags shing dpyad nas tshig tu mi smra ba la rgyu mtshan yod de/

༄༅/ /yid kyi brjod pa rtog dpyod ni rnam g.yeng yin la/ de yang ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyud 'brug byed yin par rtogs nas khyod chos ston pa'i tshe brtags shing dpyad nas tshig tu mi smra ba'i phyir/ chos can/khyod kyis sgra med par chos ston pa mi 'gal te/ chos ston pa'i sgra'i dgos pa ni 'chad pa pos chos brjod pa ltar brjod par bya ba'i chos rtogs pa'i rtogs pa nyan pa po'i rnam par shes pa la shin tu bskrun cing bskyed pa 'di yin la/ de khyod kyis lus kyi sgo nas chos bstan pa la yang yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzung don rtog pa spang phyir dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams rasbyar ba ni/shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar rang sangs rgyas kyi lam nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa brjod nas de'i rjes su rnal ma rang sangs rgyas kyi lam dngos brjod pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad zhugs pa rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam ni nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa kho na yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ khyad par gsum gyis theg chen gyi lam las dman zhing nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa'i chos bse ru lta bus mtshon pa rang sangs rgyas kyi lam rtogs par byang sems chen pos lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya'o/ /ji ltar na/ rnam mkhyen

yid la byed pas bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sgo nas so/ /'o na de byang sems kyis rnam pa thams cad du bskyed cing shes par bya ba yin nam zhe na/ byang sems kyis de rnam pa thams cad du bskyed cing shes par bya ba ma yin te/ des rang byang chub mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir/ des na/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang sangs rgyas kyi lam yon tan yar ldan du bskyed cing rdzogs par byed pa'i sems dpa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par gsum po gang zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ gzung ba phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong nus kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ gzung ba'i yul can gyi rtog pa ci rigs pa spangs pa yin te/ phyi rol gyi don bden 'dzin gyi gnyen por sngar bshad pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug dang / gzugs sogs kyi dngos po'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rten 'brel bsgoms pa'i rtogs pa yin pas so/ /chos can/ theg chen gyi lam las dman pa yin te/ rang

༄tsho/ /lam du 'dzin pa shes pa bden 'dzin gyi rtogs pa spong mi nus pa'i phyir te/ 'dzin rtog gi gnyen por phung po lnga'i gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin du rten 'brel ma bsgoms pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen gyi lam las dman pa yin te/ rten chos rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas bsdus pa'i rtogs pa'i rten gzhi theg 'bring slob pa'i gang zag de khyod kyi lam pa gang zag gi rten yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar bar ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa'i lam bstan nas rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun thob na bshad ma thag pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi 'phags pa'i lam skye bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ sbyor lam drod la gnas pa'i rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can theg 'bring pa chos can/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob tu brda las byung ba ming du btags pa tsam yin pa dang don dam par chos nyid stong pa nyid yin pa mi 'gal bar ston pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun drod skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ sbyor lam rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog

la gnas pa'i theg 'bring pa chos can/ gzugs sogs don dam par 'phel 'grib sogs med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs nang phyi sogs stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas bdag gir mi 'dzin pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas dang / gzugs sogs skye 'gag sogs med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas bden bzhi la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgoms pas nges 'byed cha mthun rtse mo dang bzod pa dang chos mchog skye zhing 'phel ba'i phyir/ gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par 'phel 'grib sogs med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong nga/'i phyir/ chos can/ don dam par nang phyi la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas bdag gir gzung bya ma yin te/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag sogs med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa byang sems kyi lam la mthong sgom gnyis las/ dang po mthong lam la/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ brgal lan dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyi mjug thog tu byang chub sems dpa'i lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg pa gsum rim gyis bgrod

༄༅/ /par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su khyad par gsum ldan gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi ni mthong lam phan yon chen po'o zhes bshad pa ste brjod do/ /dgos pa skabs dang por bstan pa'i chos bcu po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i yin gyi byang chub sems dpa'i ma yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir du byams pas brjod do/ /khyad par gsum ni byang chub sems dpas bsgom par bya ba sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yul dang yul can du 'brel ba dang ldan pa tshe 'di'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa/ skye ba gzhan gyi yon tan skye ba snga phyi du ma dran pa'o/ /de la mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ dbye na byang sems dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi mthong lam dang gsum / mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa dang / nyan thos 'phags pa dang / theg 'bring 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ byang sems kyi mthong lam la dbye na rtsa ba'i dbye ba/ chos bzod chos shes/ rjes bzod rjes shes te skad cig ma bzhi/ yan lag gi dbye ba sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po re re la chos bzod chos shes rjes bzod rjes shes bzhi
