bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /nyan rang gi mthong lam yang dbye ba de bzhin no/ /ngag don/ phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong lam chos can/ khyod skabs gnyis pa 'dir bstan pa la dgos me mde dewa wakhyod skabs gnyis pa 'dir bstan pas skabs dang po'i chos bcu po de sangs rgyas kho na'i yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong lam chos can/ skad cig ma bcu drug yod de/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi/ yan lag gi dbye ba bden bzhi re re la bzod shes skad cig ma bzhi bzhir phye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad lnga chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug po rnam pa ji lta bur bsgom par bya snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ rnam pa sgom tshul/ don dam par de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis rten dang brten pa yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas len par mi rigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa skye ba yin no/ /mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang

༄༅/ /sems chos can/ khyod kyis mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod de dmigs rnam kyi sgo nas sgom pa yin te/ khyod kyis de don dam par de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas len par mi rigs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te sgom pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma kun la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas gnyis chos can/don dam par yul dang yul can gyi rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas len par mi rigs te/ don dam par yul dang yul can du med pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs don dam par chen po mtha' dbus dang bral bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdag bsngal la chos shes skye ba yin no/ /gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par mtha' dbus dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par chos dbyings kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs de dag la don dam par rejal byed tshad ma med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos can thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa skye ba yin no/ /gzugs sogs de dag chos can/ don dam par 'jal byed tshad ma med de/ rtags snga ma de bzhin du'o/ /nam mkha' la tshad med pa bzhin gzugs sogs

de dag la don dam par gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i tshad gnyis med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man rigs 'gre'o/ /gzugs de dag chos can/ don dam par gzugs can dang gzugs can ma yin pa'i tshad gnyis med de/ rtags snga ma bzhin du'o/ /de la gzugs can ni gzugs kyi phung po yin la/ de'i tshad ni rdul phra rab la brten pa'i dbyibs yin/ gzugs can ma yin pa ni ming bzhi'i phung po yin la/ de'i tshad ni skad cig la bye brag tu smra ba 'dod do/ /mdor na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs rtag chad dang sngon dang phyi mtha' med pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ gzugs sogs chos can/ don dam par rtag chad la sogs pa'i mtha' med de/ don dam par ngo bo nyid med pas so/ /mthong lam kun 'byung la chos shes kyi yum la gnas pa'i byang sems ni chos dbyings kyi ngo pos gzugs sogs dang de bzhin gshegs pa gnyis dbyer med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ snga ma de bzhin du mthong lam kun 'byung la rjes bzod kyi yum la gnas pa'i byang sems ni chos dbyings kyi ngo bos chos thams cad la blang dor 'phel 'grib sogs med par sgom pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ ngo bo nyid med par mos pa sngon du 'gro ba'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi sgom pa'i

༄tsho/ /rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mdor na/ de lta bu ni kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa thob pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam 'gog pa chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa thob pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam 'gog pa chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'thob pa yin te/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i phyir/ yum du gnyen po rnam byang thams cad gong ma rjes mthun pa ma 'brel/ 'og ma yon tan yar ldan du tshang bar bsdus pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ theg chen gyi mthong lam 'gog pa la rjes bzod kyi yum chos can/ gnyen po rnam byang gi rigs thams cad tshang bar bsdus pa yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi la sogs pa'i nyam nga ba phyi'i 'tshe ba dang / nad dang 'dod chags la sogs pa nang gi 'tshe ba nye bar zhi ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/

theg chen gyi mthong lam 'gog pa la rjes shes chos can/ phyi nang gi 'tshe ba ci rigs pa zhi ba yin te/ gnyen po rnam byang gi rigs thams cad tshang bar bsdus pa de nyid kyis so/ /mdor na de lta bu ni 'gog bden gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /gzugs sogs dang mya ngan las 'das pa la mngon par zhen pa zhi ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la chos bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/gzugs sogs dang myang 'das la zhen pa ci rigs pa zhi ba yin te/ de'i gnyen por chos thams cad gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med par bsgom pas so/ /'das pa dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la chos shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung bskyab sba bar mdzad de/ spros bral rtogs pa'i shes rab dang gzhan don gyi thabs mkhas pa la zhugs pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ bsrung bskyab sba ba gsum ni bsrung ba chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po yin no/ /gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa dge ba bcu la gnas te sems cen gzhan yang de la 'god pa bsngags mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas man 'dra/ mthong lam lam la rjes

༄༅/ /bzod la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yin te/ bdag nyid rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu dge ba bcu la gnas nas sems can gzhan yang de nyid la 'god bsngags mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i phyir/ mthong lam lam la rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems spyin sogs mi zad par 'dod pa'i bsam pas sbyin sogs dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i rnam pa'i sgo nas chos thams cad la dmigs te bsgoms pas mthong lam lam la rjes shes skye zhing 'brel bas de'i sgo nas de la dmigs te bsgom pa la dgos pa yod do/ /'di bzhin gong ma rnams la'ang mdzod/ mthong lam lam la rjes shes la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngos pa la dgos pa yod de/ de ltar bsngos pas dge ba'i rtsa ba zad mi shes pa 'thob pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ de lta bu ni lam bden gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas sgom tshul yin no/ /mjug bsdu ba ni/ gong du bstan pa de lta bu'i theg chen gyi bzod shes rnams ni lam shes kyi skabs su bstan pa'i skad cig ma yin te/ phan yon chen po dang bcas pa'i mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa brgal lan la/

rgol ba ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan la bshad pa byed pa'i paṇḍi ta kha cig ni lam shes kyi mthong lam rgyas bshad kyi skabs 'dir/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi tshig le'ur byas pa'i don mtshon cing brjod byar lhur len pa/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces pa la sogs pa'i gzhung gis mthong lam gyi rnam pa'i don ma bshad par mthong lam gyi skad cig ma bcu drug nye bar mtshon pa nyi tshe bstan par zad de/ de'i rnam pa zhes ma smos par/ lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi skabs su bshad pa dang / sngar ma bshad pa / dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su 'chad pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun dang / sogs pa gzhi shes mthong lam gyi don ston byed kyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams kyis kyang de rnams kyi skad cig ma'i don tsam bstan pa sngar gyi de bzhin du blta bar bya'o zhes zer ro/ /lan la/ dam bca' snga ma rigs pas dgag /dam bca' gnyis pa lung rigs gnyis kyis dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag /ces pa la sogs pa'i gzhung gis rnam pa ma bstan par 'dod pa las gzhan des rnam pa bstan par 'dod pa slob dpon seng ge bzang po la sogs pa dag na re/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs

༄༅/ /rgyas dag /ces sogs kyi gzhung de dag chos can/ khyod kyis mnyam gzhag tu sgom pa'i rim pa dang / sogs pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i dus su yid la bya ba'i rim pa gang yang ma bstan par thal/khyod kyis rnam pa'i don cung zad kyang ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos can/ khyod kyis mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ khyod kyis mnyam gzhag gi dus su sgom pa'i rim pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i dus su yid la bya ba'i rim pa gang yang ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi gzhung de dag gi rnam pa ma bstan na sngar gyi rigs pas kyang gnod la/ skyon gzhan lung gi gnod pa yang yod de/ ji ltar na/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i don yang ji ltar drang zhing 'chad de/ rnam pa dang zhes pa dang / rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /zhes pa dang 'gal lo zhes zer ro/ /skabs don/ dmigs pa dang ni rnam pa dang / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ khyod kyi byang sems chen po'i sbyor lam des nyan rang gi sbyor lam las rnam pa'i sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bstan par min par thal/ khyod kyis rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad

rme sa/rne semasacanal dmigs pa'i rjes thob kyi rnarme pa gtso bor bstan par min par thal/ rtags snga ma bzhin no/ /gnyis pa sgom lam la byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis las/ nga/ spre1 ni / kun nas dul dang thams cad la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ don la skye ba'i rim pa ltar byas na mthong lam gyi mjug thog tu sgom lam/ sgom lam gyi mjug thog tu de'i byed pa brjod par bya ba yin te/ de las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ de lta na yang theg chen sgom lam de'i byed pa chos can/ khyod re zhig theg chen sgom lam gyi dang por bstan pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa yod de/ theg chen sgom lam ston pa'i mdo tshig bas khyod ston pa'i mdo tshig brjod bya nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang / theg chen sgom lam gyi gdul bya 'bras bu khyod la mos nas theg chen sgom lam la gzhol ba nyid du gzhug pa'i phyir du khyod de'i dang por bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo / bral 'bras bzhi/rnam smin gyi 'bras bu gcig /skyes bu byed 'bras gcig ste rnam pa drug yin no/ /de rnams la bral 'bras bzhi ni/ theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas rnam pa thams cad du sems rang dbang nyid du byed pas rang

༄tsho/ /rgyud kun nas dul ba dang / rang rgyud dul bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa skye bo 'dud 'os thams cad la sgo gsum gus pas 'dud pa dang / theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa zil gyis gnon cing de las rgyal ba dang / theg chen sgom lam bsgoms pas pha rol bdud la sogs pas byas pa'i gnod pa sgrub pa'i yul ma yin pas bdud sogs kyi gnod pas brdzi ba med pa dang bzhi/ de la dang po gsum nang gi 'tshe ba zhi ba/ /bzhi pa phyi'i 'tshe ba zhi ba'o/ /rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba dang / skyes bu byed 'bras ni/ theg chen sgom lam bsgom pa'i rten gyi yul sa phyogs kyang mchod pa'i rten nyid du byed pa'o/ /sa mtshams gtsor cher sa gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ ngag don/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms pas rnam pa thams cad du sems la rang dbang nyid du byed pa chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa yin te/ de'i 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir des 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar/mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa'i 'og tu theg chen gyi sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ byed pa ston pa'i mdo tshig bas

sgom lam ston pa'i mdo tshig brjod bya mang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ theg chen sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid la rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i rjes la mngon rtogs/de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo theg chen gyi zag bcas dang zag med sgom lam gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan theg chen gyi sgom lam gzhir byas pa la zag pa kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba dang de snang ba med pa gnyis yod pa'i bye brag gis so/ /dbye don de gnyis la gzhi mthun med do/ /ngag don/ theg chen sgom lam chos can/ zag bcas dang zag med sgom lam gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod la kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba dang / de snang ba med pa gnyis yod pa'i bye brag gis de gnyis su phye ba'i phyir/ gsum pa la zag bcas dang / zag med sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mdor bstan/rgyas par bshad/ dgos pa'i sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi sgom lam la gnyis yod pa de'i phyir theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /kun rdzob sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa snang ba/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo mos pa dang / bsngo ba dang / rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnam pa gsum mo/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam

༄༅/ /gzhir byas pa la/ dge ba sog pa dang / mi zad par byed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la dngos dang / phan yon gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos bsngo yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi nang nas dang por mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ dge ba mi zad par byed pa dang / 'phel bar byed pa la dge ba sog pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ mos pa'i rgyu ni lung rigs rnam dag yin la/ yul ni gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin no/ /ngo bo ni/ yum la dwangs ba'i 'dun pa grogs shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gcig yin no/ /dbye ba ni/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas yum la 'dun pa de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag dang nying lag gi dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ zag bcas sgom lam la gsum du dbye bar ma zad mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi ngo bo de

yang rang don dang / gnyis don dang / gzhan don mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam dang rnam pa gsum du shes par bya'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gzhir byas pa la sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub cing gzhan don ched du bya bas sgrub pa dang / sbyor bas gzhan don bar chad dang bcas par sgrub pa dang / gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa dang gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /dgos pa de gsum bsgoms pas ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum dang bstod bkur bsngags pa sogs 'thob bo/ /de gsum gyi mtshan nyid/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gang zhig /sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa/ gang zhig /gzhan don bar chad dang bcas par sgrub pa/ gang zhig /gzhan don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa'o/ /sa mtshams ni dang po sa gnyis pa nas bzhi pa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa sa lnga pa nas bdun pa'i bar na yod/ gsum pa sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar na yod do/ /'o na mos pa gsum sgom pa'i dang po don gsum mngon du byed par thal/ de gsum gyis yum la mos pa ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum 'thob pa'i phyir zhe na/ rang dang gnyis ka dang gzhan don la dmigs pa mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gsum chos can/ khyod kyis yum la mos pa ji

༄7/ /ltar bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum 'thob na khyod sgom pa'i dang por don gsum mngon du byed mi dgos par thal/ khyod kyi yum la mos pa ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin dge ba'i chos don gsum gyi rten yin zhing 'thob na yang khyod sgom pa'i dang por don gsum mngon du mi byed pa'i phyir te/ khyod sgom lam gyi dbang du byas pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rab kyi mthar thug pa med par slob pa'i dus su don gsum mngon du byas pa ni su la yang yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag gi dbye ba ni/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la gsum du phye bar ma zad/ mos pa gsum po de yang ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen por phye ba'i bye brag gis re re zhing rnam pa gsum gsum du 'dod do/ /nying lag gi dbye ba ni/ mos pa gsum la gsum gsum du phye bar ma zad mos pa dgu po de yang so sor chung ngu'i chung ngu / 'bring /chen po/ 'bring gi chung ngu / 'bring / chen po/ chen po'i chung ngu / 'bring / chen por dbye bas re re zhing rnam par gsum gsum yin pa de ltar na dgu tshan gsum gyis mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam la rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ shes rab pha rol tu phyin pa la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos pa

yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bstan nas de'i phan yon bstod bkur bsngags pa bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ de bsgoms pa las de 'byung ba'i phyir/ dgos pa ci phyir bstan na/ mos pa de sgom pa'i —byang chub sems dpa' spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ gong du bstan pa de ltar yum la mos pa la sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang byang sems 'phags pas bstod pa la sogs pa mdzad do zhes bstan pa'i phyir du bstod pa la sogs pa bstan no/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ 'dod do/ /gang la na/ ji ltar mos pa bsgoms pa bzhin don gsum 'thob pa'i chos kyi mtshan nyid kyi yum la sbyor bas rang don sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa dang po rang don mos pa dang / sbyor bas gnyis don sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa gnyis pa gnyis don mos pa dang / sbyor bas gzhan don kho na sgrub pa la zhugs pa'i mos pa yid la byed pa gsum pa gzhan don mos pa ste mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi gnas skabs dgu tshan gsum po rnams la'o/ /ji ltar na/ so sor dgu tshan rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas/ go rim bzhin du rang don mos pa la bstod pa dang / gnyis don mos pa la bkur ba dang / gzhan don mos pa la bsngags pa byas par 'dod do/ /dgos pa de rnams sgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gong nas gong du

༄༅/ /mngon par dga' bar byed pa'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na/ sangs rgyas kyi mchog gi sprul pa'i sku dang / sogs pa byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyis so/ /rgyu mtshan des na/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa la sogs pa 'di dag ni don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas mdzad pa'i mtshan nyid can yin gyi/ gcam bu'i ngo bo ni ma yin no/ /mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi phan yon bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam bsgoms pa'i yon tan ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas 'dud pa'i cha/ dbye na bstod bkur bsngags pa gsum/ de gsum gyi khyad par ni bstod pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po yin no/ /ngo bo ni/ yid kyi bstod pa yid dad pa/ ngag gi bstod pa ni/ yid gus pas bslang ste/ ngag tu yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod pa/ lus kyi bstod pa ni/ yid gus pas bslang ste/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa'o/ /'dir yid kyi bstod pa gtso che'o/ /ngag don ni/ shes bya chos can/ 'dir bstan gyi bstod pa la sogs pa 'di don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin rtogs nas mdzad pa yin gyi gcam bu'i ngo bo ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i skus yum la mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnams la yon tan yod pa dang mthun par bstod bkur bsngags pa

mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsngo ba ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ /zhes bya ba la sogs par gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ mos pa bstan nas gnyis pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bstan pa de ltar yum la mos pa las dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba 'byung bas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo par byed do / /gang na/ rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad do/ /dgos pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub ma thob bar mi zed par byed pa'i phyir du'o/ /gang gis na/ theg pa gsum gyis gdul bar bya ba'i sems can la theg pa gsum gyi lam ston pa'i rgyu'i ngo bo byed pa dang ldan pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnams kyis so/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ thabs shes khyad par can gnyis kyi sgo nas so/ /des na theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sem/sa can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba de bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bcu gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mngon zhen bcu gnyis kyi gnyen por yul ba du gnyis kyi

༄༅/ /sgo nas bcu gnyis su phye'o/ /bcu gnyis po gang zhe na/ sngar bshad pa'i mos pa khyad par can zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /bla med byang chub la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs te rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba/ mi dmigs pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /zag med kyi phung po lnga la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis man 'dra/ zag med kyi phung po lnga ni tshul khrims dang / shes rab dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po'o/ /phyin ci ma log pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /bsngo bar byed pa'i sems la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis man 'dra/dben pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /bdag gzhan dang ldan pa'i dngos po la mi dmigs pa man 'dra/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin dran pa zhes ming du btags pa'i man 'dra/ gang zhig /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dge ba la mi dmigs pa man 'dra/ thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa'i zhes ming du btags pa man 'dra/ gang zhig /sbyin sogs drug la mi dmigs man

'dra / mtshan ma med pa zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /sngon po la sogs pa'i mtshan ma la mi dmigs man 'dra/ sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /lam thams cad la mi dmigs man 'dra/ khams gsum par ma gtogs par zhes ming du man 'dra/ gang zhig /'dod pa la sogs pa khams gsum la mi dmigs man 'dra/ chung da nga 'bring dang chen po zhes ming du man 'dra/gang zhig /dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam sogs dang / rgyun du zhugs pa la sogs pa dang / bla med byang chub la gnas pa la mi dmigs man 'dra/ sogs dang pos bsam gtan bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/gzugs med bzhi/ mngon shes lnga'o/ /sogs gnyis pas phyir 'ong / phyir mi 'ong / dgra bcom pa'o/ /chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam rnam pa gsum po chos can/ bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bdag nyid yin te/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyis dge ba bcu sogs 'thob pa'i bsod nams yod na dang / rgyun zhugs sogs 'thob pa'i dang / stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad bla med byang chub la gnas pa la sems can de snyed kyis mchod pa'i bsod nams yod na/ de bas khyod bsgoms pa'i bsod nams lhag pa'i phyir/ so sor

༄༅/ /sbyor mdzod/ ngag don/ sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba'i rtogs pa chos can/ mos pa khyad par can zhes ming du btags pa'i bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig /bla med byang chub la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis dmigs te rang gzhan gyis bsags pa'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsgyur ba yin pa'i phyir/ chos can des gzhan thams cad la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i rjes thob na yod/ gsum pa yi rang ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ bsngo ba bstan nas gsum pa rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa'i sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gong du bstan pa de ltar legs par bsngos pa las byung ba'i bsod nams yi rang gis mngon par spel bar bya ba yin pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems chen pos dbul pos gter rnyed pa ltar rab tu dga' bar sems kyis rang gzhan gyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la dmigs nas rjes su yi rang bar byed pa yin no/ /

gang gi sgo nas na/ kun rdzob tu rnam mkhyen yid la byed pa'i thabs mkhas dang don dam par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sgo nas so/ /des na sa gnyis pa la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud kyi thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang yid la byed pa'i rtogs pa ni/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba la yi rang sgom pa'i phyir/ rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam yin par lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir brjod do/ /sa mtshams gong dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum rgyas par bshad pa de la bsdus pa'i don ni mos pa yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ khyod de sgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ /khyod bsgoms pas bsod nams rgya chen po mngon par 'du byed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ gser gyi 'byung khungs bzang po nas gser gyi gar bu 'byung ba bzhin du'o/ /bsngo ba yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod bsgoms pas mos pas 'dus byas pa'i bsod nams de rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur byed pa'i phyir / ji ltar na/ gser gyi gar bu de gser mgar mkhas pas bzo byas te mi la sogs pa'i rgyan du byed pa bzhin du'o/ /rjes su yi rang yid la byed pa bla na med pa'i sgom lam chos can/ chos 'dra/ khyod

༄tsho/ /bsgoms pas blo mnyam na rang gzhan gyi bsod nams byas pa mnyam po 'thob pa'i phyir/ ji ltar na/ rgyan btags pas rang gzhan la mdzes pa bzhin du'o zhes bya ba 'di yin no/ /gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ zag bcas sgom lam gyi 'og tu zag med sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum sgom pa rnam par mi rtog pas zin dgos pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam gzhag ni theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye na sgrub pa dang rnam dag sgom lam rnam pa gnyis so/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan zag med sgom lam la bar chad med lam dang / rnam grol lam gnyis yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so / /gnyis pa la sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ zag med sgom lam la gnyis yod pa de'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ gnyis kyi nang nas dang por rnam mkhyen mngon par sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sgrub pa sgom lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ bar chad med lam ni rang 'bras rnam

grol lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su gzugs sogs kyi rang bzhin phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam ni sgrub pa sgom lam de'i ngo bo yin no/ /ngag don/ sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam yin te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su gzugs sogs kyi rang bzhin phyin ci ma log par mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam yin pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam ni zag bcas sgom lam las mchog yin te/ rnam par mi rtog pas ma zin par gzhan mos bsngo yi rang yid la byed pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob pa'i phyir/ sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ chos kun la mtshan mar 'du mi byed de/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ de rnam pa'o/ /byed las la gnas skabs kyi byed las ni/ gong du bstan pa de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid dang mchog nyid dang rnam pa dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam sgye rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la chos rnams rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa ni gtod par byed pa yin no/ /ngag don

༄༅/ /sgrub pa sgom lam chos can/ khyod bsgom pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod kyis rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ mthar thug gi byed las ni/ chos can / don chen po yin te/ khyod kyis rang sgom byed rnal 'byor pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'thob par byed pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam na yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen bshad/ 'bras bu rnam dag sgom lam dngos dang gsum/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ sgrub pa sgom lam bstan nas de'i 'og tu chos gang zhig gzung bas rnam dag sgom lam 'thob pa rnam dag sgom lam 'di'i mthun rkyen dang / chos gang zhig bor bas rnam dag sgom lam 'thob pa rnam dag sgom lam 'di'i 'gal rkyen gang yin snyam pa'i the tshom bsal ba'i sgo nas gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ de'i snyo nas de bstan pas rnam dag sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen legs par shes pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'o na rkyen gnyis po gang zhe na/ sa gnyis pa man chad du sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku bsten nas bsnyen bkur gyis mnyes par byed pa dang / rjes thob tu sbyin sogs phar phyin drug ci rigs pa rdzogs par byed pa dang / mnyam gzhag tu zhi

gnas la mnyam par 'jog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa gang yin ni chos can/ rang 'bras rnam dag sgom lam gyi mthun rkyen yin te/ rang 'bras rnam dag sgom lam 'di sgom pa la mos pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ de la phan btags stobs kyis de'i rjes su 'gro ldog bya sa yin pa'i phyir/ bdud kyis zil gyis non te gnod pa byas pa dang / chos zab mo rang bzhin spros bral la ma mos shing sdang ba dang / phung po sogs la bden par zhen zhing 'dzin pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i grogs pos yongs su zin te 'grogs pa ni chos can/ rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i 'gal rkyen yin te/ rang 'bras chos spong gi las kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/de la phan btags stobs kyis de'i rjes su 'gro ldog bya sa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la spyir bstan/ khyad par du bstan/ shin tu ba dang cig shos su bstan/ shin tu ba bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni / 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar rnam dag sgom lam 'thob pa dang mi 'thob pa'i rgyu bshad nas skabs su bab pa'i rnam dag 'phags bzhi'i spyir thun mong du bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi 'gal rkyen spangs mthun rkyen tshang ba las rnam dag sgom lam skye ba'i phyir/ tshig don

༄༅/ /'byed pa ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dge sbyong gi tshul bar chad med lam gyi 'bras bu rnam grol gyi lam de chos can/ khyod rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam dag de dang / khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid khyod kyi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang byas dag pa'i rnam dag gnyis dbyer med pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ de lta bu'i dag pa de gnyis rang dang sbyi'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas tha dad ma yin zhing / khyad par gyi chos mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas so sor gcad du med pas so/ /chos can/ de ltar med de/ de lta bu'i rnam dag de gnyis dag gzhi chos nyid gcig gi steng du dag bya gzugs sogs la bdag sogs su zhen pa'i dri ma gcig dag byed bar chad med lam gcig gis dag par byas pa'i rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'bras bu dag pas gzugs sogs dag par brjod do/ /rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam rdzogs rjes su chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam/dbye na sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lam dgu/ sa mtshams yang de na yod/ gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/

shes bya chos can/ glo bur rnam dag 'phags bzhi'i thun mong du brjod nas de'i rjes su khyad par so sor phye nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyad par gyi sgo nas spyi rtogs dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni / nyan thos kyi rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu mtshan gzhi/ slob ma nyan thos kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i theg pa chung ngu'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /theg 'bring mthong lam pa'i rnam grol lam mtshan gzhi/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya nyon mongs pa dang shes sgrib gzung rtog spangs pa'i theg pa 'bring po'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi rnam grol lam mtshan gzhi/ rgyal sras byang sems kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ rang gi dngos rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi spang bya theg pa gsum gyi lam gsum gyi mi mthun phyogs sgrib pa gsum spangs pa'i theg chen slob pa'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /chos dbyings thabs dang bcas pa bsgoms pa las byung ba'i rnam dag shin tu ba chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag yin te/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtshan

༄༅/ /gzhi / sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag tu mtshon/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnam pa kun spangs pa'i rnam grol mtshan nyid do/ /de'i phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ni rnam dag shin tu ba yin no zhes dngos su bstan pas dang po gsum rnam dag shin tu ba min te/ sgrib pa phyogs re las ma spangs pa'i phyir zhes shugs la bstan to/ /gsum pa ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas lam shes 'chad pa'i skabs su byang sems kyi rnam dag smos pa'i zhar la sangs rgyas dang nyan rang gi rnam dag shin tu ba dang cig shos su bshad pa de ji lta bu yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag de rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i theg chen gyi sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa'i dri ma dgu'i gnyen por chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam dgu ni/ rang gi spang bya sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnam pa thams cad du rnam par dag pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ nyan rang gi rnam dag ni/ cig shos shin tu ba ma yin

pa'i rnam dag yin te/ khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i nyan rang gi sgom spang chen po'i chen po la sogs pa'i dri ma dgu'i gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i nyan rang gi sgom lam bar chad med lam dgu ni/cig shos rang gi spang bya'i dri ma phyogs re tsam dag pa'i rgyu yin gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags spong mi nus pa'i phyir/ khams gsum sa dgu ni/ 'dod khams sa gcig /gzugs khams bsam gtan sa bzhi/gzugs med khams snyoms 'jug sa bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod la brten nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ji ltar shin tu ba yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag ni rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ dpes klan ka spangs pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam shin tu ba de rang gi spang bya khams gsum sa dgu la brten pa'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi sgom lam shin tu ba de chos can/ de'i gnyen po yin te/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas 'jal byed shes pa dang gzhal bya shes bya gnyis rang

༄༅/ /bzhin mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi bar chad med lam mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ dpes klan ka spangs pa'i sgo nas bstan na/ klan ka ni gang / dpe ni ji lta bu zhe na/ gong du gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pas spang bya chen po'i chen po la sogs pa spong byas pa de la/ kha cig na re/ de mi 'thad de/ gnyen po ni chen po'i chen po la sogs pa yin zhing / mi mthun phyogs ni chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa rigs so zhes bya ba'i klan ka rgol lo/ /spong byed lan ni/ don dam par ni 'dod de/ don dam par phan gnod gang yang ma grub pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob tu rtags ma grub ste spang bya rags pa sel ba la gnyen po stobs chung ngus chog cing / spang bya phra zhing phra ba sel ba la gnyen po stobs chen dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na gos la chags pa'i dri ma rags pa sel ba la bco blag mkhan gyis 'bad pa chung ngus chog la/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma shin tu phra mo bsal ba la btso blag mkhan che thang du 'bad dgos pa bzhin no/ /des na de lta bu'i dpes de lta bu'i klan ka spangs pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni / mdor na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyinapa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ces bya ba las rgyu lam shes gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs gnyis pa'i 'grel pa don gsal ba'i rgyan ces bya ba re

zhig rdzogs so// /// de ltar skabs gnyis pas rgyu'i bdag nyid kyi lam shes rdzogs par bstan nas/ da ni skabs gsum pas gzhi shes kyi yan lag rgyas par 'chad pa la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/mtshon byed kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas mjug bsdu/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ shes bya chos can/ rgyu lam shes bstan nas de'i rjes su thams cad shes pa nyid bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par lam legs par shes pa med pas so/ /gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gang zhig /spangs rtogs nyi tshe bar gyur pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud kho na la yod/ gnyis pa la srid zhi la gnas mi gnas kyi khyad par/ 'bras yum la nye ring gi khyad par/spang bya dang gnyen po'i khyad par/ de gnyis kyi gnas lugs sgom tshul gyi khyad par/ bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu'i khyad par/ sgom lam dngos su mi ston pa'i rgyun mtshan no/ /dang po la/ dngos su byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin spangs par bstan/ shugs la nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin ma spangs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la nye bar

༄༅/ /'dod pa'i byang sems kyi yum gzhi shes chos can/ chos kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis tshu rol gyi mtha' 'khor ba rtag pa'i mtshan nyid dang / gzhan don du 'bor bar dngos su 'jug nus pa'i snying rjes pha rol gyi mtha' myang 'das chad pa'i mtshan nyid dang / de gnyis kyi bar theg chen gyi lam la yang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis mi gnas pa yin te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba ni rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyun gyi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid dang / myang 'das ni nyan thos pa kha cig lhag med kyi myang 'das thob pa na phung po lnga rgyun chad par 'dod pas de la chad pa'i mtshan nyid ces bstan to/ /des na byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes chos can/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes yin te/ phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i mkhyen pa gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das bar gsum la mtshan mar mi 'dzin pas so/ /de'i mtshan nyid de yin no/ /sa mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gnyis pa ni/ kun shes 'chad pa'i skabs su nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyis 'khor 'das la mtshan 'dzin spangs pa las bzlog te ma

spangs par bstan pas na nyan rang gis bdag med rtogs pa tsam gyi yum gzhi shes chos can/ 'khor 'das la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ma spangs pa yin te/ gzhan don du 'khor bar dngos su 'jug nus pa'i snying rje dang 'gor 'das la blang dor gyi mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po 'khor 'das rang bzhin ma dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bral ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis dngos po 'bor ba dang dngos po med pa myang 'das la mtshan ske mar dmigs pa ma spangs pa'i phyir te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du ma shes pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir gnyen po gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum dang ring bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rang sde kha cig na re/ klu sgrub kyi lugs rtsa sher las/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang yin pa de nyid kyi rang bzhin stong par thub pa khyod ni bzhed ces 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pa ni gzhi rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa kho na yin la de yang nyan rang byang sems thams cad la yod pa ma yin nam/ des na ji ltar na nyan rang la yang dag pa'i yum ring ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' la yang dag pa'i yum cig 31sa nye bar 'gyur zhe

༄༅/ /na / de lta bu'i dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir tshigs bcad gcig smos so/ /ngag don/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ dgos pa yod de/khyod la brten nas ji ltar na nyan rang la yang dag pa'i yum ring ba dang byang chub sems dpa' la nye bar 'gyur snyam pa'i dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ lan gyi sgo nas tshig don 'byed pa la/ nyan rang la ring ba'i rgyu mtshan byang sems la nye ba'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa tsam thams cad la yod pa'i phyir zer na khyab pa ma grub/ theg chen gyi phyi nang gi yongs 'dzin khyad par can gyis gzung ba'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis rten 'brel rang bzhin med par rtogs pa thams cad la yod pa'i phyir zer na/ rtags ma grub ste/ 'dzin rtog gi gnyen por chos kyi gnas lugs mi shes pa'i nyan rang de dag chos can/ byang sems chen po la ltos te khyod la 'bras yum ring ba yin te/ khyod kyi rgyud la thabs shes khyad par gyi sgo nas dus gsum rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa med pa'i phyir/ chos can tsho/ de med de/ khyod mthun rkyen phyi'i yongs 'dzin theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / nang gi yongs 'dzin rnam mkhyen yid byed la sogs pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ 'gal rkyen tshor ba

la sogs pa'i dngos po mtshan mar rtog pa 'dzin rtog cung zad kyang ma spangs pas so/ /dper na skye bo mang po'i dbus su sgyu ma mkhan gyis 'jim dum sogs la rta glang sogs su sprul pa'i dngos po rta glang sogs snang ba la de'i ngo bo mi shes pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig gis rta glang sogs su mngon par zhen pa nyid kyis de rnams la rta glang sogs kyi ngo bo med par mi shes pa bzhin no/ /sanyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags rnga/ de dag ni chos can/ nyan rang la ltos te khyod la 'bras yum yang dag par nye ba yin te/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ thabs shes khyad par can gyi sgo nas dus gsum pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa yin te/ khyod dus yun ring mo zhig nas theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag par mgu bar byas pa las byung ba'i man ngag phyin ci ma log pa can bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab bskyed pa'i thabs la mkhas pas tshor ba sogs la mngon par zhen pa'i 'khrul ba 'dzin rtog gi mtshan ma ci rigs pa spangs pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa yongs su shes pa de nyid mnyam pa nyid du yongs

༄༅/ /su shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ ring ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can dang ldan pa ma yin pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ring ba ma yin pa nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /thabs shes khyad par can zung 'brel yin pa/ sa mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gsum pa la/ gzhi lam la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen/ de dag gi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ spang bya ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gong du bstan pa de ltar nyan rang gi yum gzhi shes ni gnyen po gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum la ring bar gyur to/ /de'i sgrub byed mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i phyir zhes ston par byed do/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos can/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes ni byang sems kyi gzhi shes la ltos te 'bras yum la ring ba yin te/ gzugs sogs phung po lnga la gzhan mu stegs pas kun nas sgro btags pa'i bdag dang sems can la sogs pas stong pa nyid du bden par lta ba'i 'du shes dang / zag bcas dang zag med dang de gnyis dzi'i ngo bo dus gsum du gtogs

pa'i chos rnams la tha dad du bden par lta ba'i 'du shes dang / sbyin sogs phar phyin drug dang / byang phyogs so bdun rnams la sgrub cing bden par lta ba'i 'du shes ni/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa'i phyir/ de la so sor skye ba'i chos rnams ni zag bcas dang / mi slob pa'i chos rnams ni zag med dang / slob pa'i chos rnams ni de gnyis ga'i ngo bo zhes bstan to/ /kha cig na re/ de lta bu'i 'du shes gsum mi mthun phyogs yin pa mi 'thad de/ de gsum rim pa bzhin gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs su 'dzin pa dang / dus gsum gyi chos rnams gcig tu 'dzin pa dang / ser sna la sogs pa'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir zer na/ yang gi khongs nas so/ /ma khyab ste gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs kyis stong pa nyid du bden par lta ba'i 'du shes chos can/ khyod rang gi spang bya gzugs sogs mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs su 'dzin pa de dag gi gnyen po yin na yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ khyod de'i gnyen po yin na yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ de'i gnyen po yin na yang / de'i spang bya yin te/ khyod gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu zhugs/ gnyen po gzhi shes de gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs

༄༅/ /la yang dag par zhugs shing / des khyod 'joms nus pas so/ /chos can/ gzugs sogs kyi gnas lugs la phyin ci log tu zhugs pa yin te/ gzugs sogs de mu stegs pas btags pa'i bdag sogs kyis stong par bden par ma grub pa la de des stong par bden par dmigs pa nyid kyis so/ /des gzhan gnyis kyang rigs 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /ces sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas byang sems chen po rnams kyi gnyen po gzhi shes de mtshan 'dzin las bzlog ste de'i gnyen por yin pa rtogs pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ gnyen po gzhi shes chos can/ rnam pa thams cad du gzhi lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po yin te/ gzhi lam gyi gnas lugs la yang dag par zhugs pa'i phyir dang / gzhi lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chags pa'i tshogs rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'gog par byed pa'i ye shes yin pas so/ /de'i byed las ni/ 'khor gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas sbyin sogs la ngar 'dzin pa'i yul bdag med par rtogs pa la rang gnas nas/ gdul bya gzhan rmongs pa la gdams ngag ston/ bag med par gnyen po

len du 'jug /zhum pa la gzengs bstod/ legs par zhugs pa la mthun pas dga' bar byed pa'i sgo nas sbyin sogs bdag med par rtogs pa de la sbyor bar byed do/ /ngag don ni/ chos can/ gzhan don byed pa'i las can yin te/ sbyin sogs bdag med par rtogs pa la rang gnas nas gdul bya gzhan yang de la sbyor bar byed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la spang bya dang / gnyen po gnyis/ dang po la/ chags pa'i rtags kyis mi mthun phyogs su sgrub/ zab pa'i rtags kyis mi mthun phyogs su sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang / dge ba gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i 'du shes chos can/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i chags pa yin pa'i phyir/ de mthar 'dzin can gyis chags par rtogs dka' bas phra mo zhes bstan to/ /de mi 'thad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ma dad pa dang / dge ba rang gi tshe 'di'i ched tsam du bsngo ba'i 'du shes kyi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir zer na/ rang 'bras de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa las byung ba la sogs pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu yin pa nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la ma dad pa la sogs pa de dag gi gnyen po yin mod/ de lta na yang rnam pa thams cad du gnyen po ma yin

༄༅/ /pas skyon med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /ces pa'i tshigs bcad phyed chos can/ don yod de/ yang ji ltar chags pa phra mo mi mthun pa'i phyogs yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ shes bya chos/ can/de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs gnas su bden par dmigs pa'i 'du shes yang gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de de kho nar skyabs gnas yin min gyi spros bral zab pa yin pa'i phyir / chos can/ de bzhin gshegs pa de de kho nar skyabs gnas yin min spros bral de zab pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ chos kyi lam ste rigs rnams rang bzhin gyis rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ mdor na / mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /gzhi lam 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa 'joms par mi nus pa/ sa mtshams theg dman 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod/ gnyis pa la/spong byed gnyen po dang / zab pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum/ dang po ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams

sbyar ba ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong ba yin/ /zhes pa'i tshigs chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas 'o na mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa de ji ltar spong snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i mnyam gzhag par chad med lam de chos can/ rang gi spang bya mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa spong ba yin te/ gzugs la sogs pa shes pa dang shes bya'i chos rnams thams cad ra si bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid du mngon sum du shes pa'i theg chen gyi bar chad med lam yin pas so/ /mdor na/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig /chos thams cad rang bzhin ma dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du shes pa'i sgo nas rang gi spang bya mtshan 'dzin gyi chags pa spong byed kyi theg chen gyi bar chad med lam/ sa mtshams byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag bar chad med lam na yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis/ /de ni rtogs par dka' bar bshad/ /ces pa'i tshig chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas yang ji ltar chos rnams kyi rang bzhin de zab pa yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de chos can/ mthar 'dzin can gyi blo ngor zab pa yin te/

༄༅/ /de'i blos rtogs pa dka' ba'i don yin pa'i phyir/ chos can/ des rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ yongs gcod du mig gi rnam par shes pas mthong ba dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pas thos pa dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pas nges pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pas rnam par shes pa dang / thams cad kyi mngon par shes pas bkag pa ste/ yongs gcod du rnam par shes pa thams cad kyis dmigs pa bsal bas so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gzugs la sogs pa mi shes phyir/ /de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod/ /ces pa'i tshig chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas yang chos rnams kyi rang bzhin de ji ltar rtogs par dka' ba yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/tshig don 'byed pa ni/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de ni chos can/ mthar 'dzin can gyi blos rtogs par dka' ba yin te/ mthar 'dzin can gyi bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ mthar 'dzin can gyi skyes bu de chos can/ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin spros bral de khyod kyi bsam pa'i yul las 'das pa yin te/ gang gi phyir na/ khyod kyis gzugs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i rnam pa'i bar gyi rang

bzhin mi shes pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ mi mthun gnyen po'i phyogs dag gis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ gong du bstan pa de ltar mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen bo'i phyogs rgyas par brjod nas de'i rjes su de gnyis kyi mjug bsdu gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyas par bshad pa don bsdu ba'i sgo nas shes dngo/sa pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/thams cad shes pa nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su sngar de ltar ji skad bshad pa bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /gang gis na/ byang sems chen pos so/ /gang na/ nyan rang gi mkhyen pa mi mthun phyogs dang byang sems dang sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rab tu dbye ba ma lus pa skabs gsum pa'i skabs 'dir shes par bya'o/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems chen pos thams cad shes pa nyid 'chad pa'i skabs 'dir mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i dbye ba ma lus pa shes dgos te/ byang sems chen pos shes par bya ba'i phyir du byams pa mgon pos skabs gsum pa 'dir spang gnyen gyi dbye ba rgyas par bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la dngos dang / mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/

༄༅/ /gong du bstan pa de ltar mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i dbye ba brjod nas de'i rjes su 'di gnyis kyi gnas lugs shes nas mi dmigs par bsgom pa'i sbyor ba bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ spang gnyen gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don bsgoms pas gtan la dbab dgos pa'i phyir/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang / /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas spang gnyen gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don de dag bsgom pa'i sbyor ba gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor ba/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi sbyor ba dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor zhing sgom mo/ /gang gis na/ byang sems chen pos so/ /gang la dmigs nas na/ yul bcu po de dang de la dmigs nas so/ /ji ltar na/rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs pa'i sgo nas so/ /des na rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas mi dmigs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni spyod pa bkag pa'i gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo rnam pa bcu'o/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yul bcu yod pas so/ /phye ba'i sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun

rmetha'i bar na yod bcu po gang zhe na/ gzhi'i ngo bo la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi ngo bo la zhen sgod mngon gyur pa spangs name mi dmigs —par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ gzhi'i khyad par la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas gzugs sogs kyi khyad par mi rtag stong nyid so gas 'a phozhen spyod mngon gyur pa spang 5 nas sogs 'dra/ mtshan nyid dang spang gnyen la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi gzugs sogs dang / chags pa dang bcas pa dang / chags pa med pa la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas sogs 'dra/ de la rdzogs pa dang ma rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs ni byis pa rnams kyis gzugs sogs su ma grub pa la gzugs sogs su btags pa'i cha kun btags te/btags pa ltar ngo bor med cing mtshan nyid kyis stong pas yon tan gyi rten du ma rdzogs pa'i phyir de la ma rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs zhes bstan no/ /gzugs sogs kyi chos nyid yongs grub de mngon sum du rtogs na sgrib pa spong zhing yon tan gyi tshogs dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de la rdzogs pa'i gzugs sogs zhes bstan to/ /mi 'gyur ba dang byed pa po med pa la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ yum rang bzhin spros

༄༅/ /bral ni bstan ma bstan gyis 'phel 'grib mi byed pas gzhan du mi 'gyur ba yin la/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas yum rang bzhin spros bral gzhan du mi 'gyur ba la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ chos rnams kyi chos nyid ni bsngags pa brjod ma brjod kyis sems chags pa dang khong khro bar mi byed pas byed pa po med pa yin la/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas chos rnams kyi chos nyid byed pa po med pa la zhen spyod sogs 'dra / bya dka' ba rnam pa gsum la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas ched du bya ba dang / sbyor ba dang / byed pa bya dka' ba nyid la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ de rnams gang zhe na/ sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir du go cha bgos pa ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi nang nas rnam mkhyen gyi bdag nyid ched du bya ba bya dka' ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du lam gsum rang bzhin mi dmigs par sgom pa ni lam shes kyi bdag nyid sbyor ba bya dka' ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rtsol ba byed pa ni gzhi shes kyi bdag nyid byed pa bya dka' ba ste rnam pa gsum mo/ /ngag don ni/ byang sems 'phags pa chos can/ ched du bya ba bya dka' ba spyad pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i ched du go cha

bgos pa'i phyir/ chos can/ sbyor ba bya dka' ba spyod pa yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du lam gsum rang bzhin mi dmigs par sgom pa'i phyir/ chos can/ byed pa bya dka' ba spyod pa yin te/sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rtsol ba byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la khyab pa yod de/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'dam bu'i tshal la sogs pa ltar yongs su gang bar gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bskal pa'am bskal pa bas lhag par chos bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa re res kyang sems can grangs dang tshad dang dpag tu ma mchis pa mya ngan las 'das kyang / sems can gyi khams la bri ba'am gang ba med pa'i phyir/ mdo ji bzhin no/ /'bras bu yod pa la spyod pa bkag pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ spyod pa bkag pa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba chos can/ 'bras bus mi stong pa yin te/ khyod bsgoms pas skal pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'bras bu byang chub gsum 'thob pas so/ /gzhan la rag las pa med pa la spyod pa batshokag pa'i ni/ rnam mkhyen skrod la byed pas srung byed gzhan gyi rkyen gyis mi 'gro ba la zhen spyod sogs 'dra/ spyod pa bkag pa'i gzhi shes sbyor ba chos can/ srung byed gzhan la

༄༅/ /rag las pa med de/ khyod la gnas na gnas pa po de nyid khyod kyis bsrung bskyab sba bar byed pa'i phyir/ shes byed snang ba bdun la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas dngos po rnams rang bzhin ma dmigs par shes par byed pa snang ba bdun la zhen spyod mngon gyur pa spangs nas ma dmigs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ shes byed bdun po gang zhe na/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong na bza' btung la sogs pa'i dngos po'i tha snyad thams cad mi 'thad par thal lo zhe na/ don dam par cir yang ma grub pas mi 'dod pa sgrub pa med la/ kun rdzob tu ma khyab ste/ bza' btung la sogs pa chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa rmi lam nang gi bza' btung la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ gnyid dang 'dra ba'i bag chags yongs su 'gyur ba snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ kha dog la sogs pa'i sgo nas gzugs la sogs pa dmigs pa de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa sgyu ma'i rta glang la sogs pa lta bu yin te/ sgyu ma'i sngags rdzas dang 'dra ba'i zhabrul pa'i rgyu rkyen mnyam du tshogs pa las byung ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ sems sems byung rnams dmigs yul la dmigs nas 'byung ba de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa smig rgyu la chur snang ba lta bu yin te/

smig rgyu chur 'gal ba ltar bden bar 'gal ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs rnams chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa brag cha lta bu yin te/ brag cha sgra gzhan gyi rkyen la rag las pa ltar brjod 'dod la sogs pa'i rgyu rkyen la rag las pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ rgyu 'bras 'dra bar 'byung ba chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa gzugs brnyan lta bu yin te/ rang rgyu bag chags mthun pa las 'dra bar snang ba tsam yin gyi rdzas dngos su ma 'phos pa'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po rnams rang gi rgyu rkyen la brten pa chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa dri za'i grong khyer lta bu yin te/ rten bden pa ba med par 'byung ba'i snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ skyes bu rnams 'gro 'ong sogs byed pa de chos can/ kun rdzob tu snang yang bden par ma grub pa sprul pa lta bu yin te/don dam par byed pa po min bzhin du snang ba de yin pa'i phyir/ mdor na byang sems kyi spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba rnam pa bcu po rjes su 'gro ba nyan rang gi sbyor ba shugs la 'phen pa'i sgo nas bstan to/ /gnyis pa ni / de ltar bstan pas shugs kyis nyan thos slob pa dang theg 'bring slob pa rnams ji skad bshad pa gzhan don du rnam mkhyen yid la byed pa'i sgo nas sgom pa las bzlog te rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas phyi

༄༅/ /nang gi chos ji snyed pa la dmigs nas sbyor bar byed pa yin pas na nyan rang sbyor lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba yin par mtshon/ rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas phyi nang gi chos ji snyed pa rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par rtogs nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ sbyor ba'i 'og tu mnyam pa nyid bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo nas sbyor ba bsgom dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa'i gnas skabs su shes pa dang shes bya la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid yin pas de dbye gzhi/ dbye ngo dngos po rdeng / mtshan ma dang / spros pa dang / rtogs pa la mnyam pa nyid bzhi yin no/ /'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan spang bya rlom pa bzhi yod pas de'i gnyen po bzhir phye'o/ /bzhi po gang zhe na/ gzugs la sogs pa dngos po dang /sngon po la sogs pa mtshan ma dang / gcig gnyis la sogs pa spros pa dbye ba dang / nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa rtogs pa rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa ni yul mnyam pa nyid yin la/ spyod pa bkag

pa'i sbyor ba bsgom pa'i skabs su gzugs la sogs pa dngos po dang / sngon po la sogs pa mtshan ma dang / gcig gnyis la sogs pa spros pa dang / nges 'byed cha mthun la sogs pa rtogs pa la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi ni yul can spyod pa bkag pa'i spyor ba de'i mnyam pa nyid dngos po dang / mtshan ma dang / spros pa dang / rtogs pa mnyam pa nyid yin no/ /rlom pa ni mngon zhen no/ /sbyor lam la gnas pa'i byang sems chen po'i rgyud kyis gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid yin te/ spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa'i skabs su shes pa dang shes bya la rlom pa bsal nas mi dmigs pa mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la ngo bo mdor bstan/ rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sdug bsngal la sogs bden pa la/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/mnyam pa nyid bstan nas de'i 'og tu mthong lam bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid so sor rtogs nas mthong lam sgom dgos pas so/ /tshig don 'byed pa ni/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud

༄tsho/ /kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi po re re la chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / chos shes pa'i ye shes dang / rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang / rjes su shes pa'i ye shes te skad cig ma bcu drug po 'di chos can/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi skabs su bstan pa'i mthong lam yin te/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad bzhi chos can/ don yod de/ khyod la brten nas bden bzhi'i rnam pa bcu drug gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la/ dngos bstan theg chen gyi mthong lam/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam gnyis/ dang po la/rnam pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa dang / mjug bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcu drug po re re la yul dang yul can gnyis gnyis yod pas/ sdug bsngal la chos bzod la yul ni/ gzugs sogs kyi skabs stobs kyis bden bzhi mtshon pas/ sdug bden don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa de sdug bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bden chos can/

don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin te/ khyod don dam par de dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ yul can ni sdug bden gyi chos rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa mngon sum du gtso bor gsal la nges pa 'dren nus su rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam mthong lam skad cig dang po de mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa yin la/ mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod chos can / sdug bden de don dam par rtag mi rtag gang yang ma yin par rtogs pa yin te/ de don dam par de dang bral bar rtogs pa'i phyir te/ de gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams su yang sbyor mdzod/ sdug bden gyi chos rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba de sdug bden gyi rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bden chos can/ don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par sdag bsngal yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ sdug bden gyi chos rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ sdug bden chos can/ri rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ don dam par bdag gi bas stong mi stong dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo po nyid med pa'i phyir/ sdug bden gyi

༄༅/ /chos don dam par skye 'gag kun nas nyon mongs rnam byang 'phel 'grib sogs ma yin pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa man 'dra/ sdug bden chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag sogs ma yin te/don dam par ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba de kuna'abyung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba yin te/ don dam par rgyu yin min gyis stong pa'i phyir te/ gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i chags pa thams cad dang bral ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par rtsa nyon nye nyon thams cad dang bral ba yin te/ don dam par kun 'byung yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par yongs su 'dzin pa las grol ba de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par yongs su 'dzin pa las grol ba yin te/ don dam par rab tu skye mi skye dang bral ba'i phyir/ man 'dra/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par rang

gi ngo bo brjod du med pa de kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par rang gi ngo bo brjod du med de/ don dam par rkyen yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par 'gog bden 'di'i don tshig tu brjod pas rgyud gzhan la sbyin du med pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ 'gog bden chos can/ don dam par khyod kyi don tshig tu brjod pa'i sgo nas rgyud gzhan la sbyin du med de/ gang gi phyir/ don dam par 'gog pa yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par dmigs pa med pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/don dam par dmigs pa med de/ don dam par zhi ma zhi dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis las 'das shing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par mtha' gnyis las 'das shing rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par yin te/ don dam par gya nom yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ 'gog bden gyi chos don dam par nad thams cad mi skye ba de 'gog bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par nad thams cad mi skye ba yin te/ don dam par nges 'byung yod med dang bral ba'i phyir te

༄༅/ /man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos ngan song chad pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ lam bden chos can/ don dam par ngan song chad pa yin te/ don dam par lam bden yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos don dam par 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i don gyi thabs la rnam par mi rtog pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ lam bden chos can/ don dam par 'bras bu mngon du bya ba'i don gyi thabs la rnam par mi rtog pa yin te/ don dam par rigs pa yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi don dam par chos thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ma 'brel pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par chos thams cad kyi mtshan ma dang ma 'brel ba yin te/ don dam par sgrub pa yin min dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ lam bden gyi chos don dam par brjod bya'i dngos po shes bya dang rjod byed sga gnyis po la so sor snang ba'i shes pa skye ba med pa de lam bden gyi rnam pa yin te man 'dra/ chos can/ don dam par ming don gnyis la so sor snang ba'i shes pa skye ba med de/ don dam par nges 'byin yin smren dang bral ba'i phyir te man 'dra/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yid la byed pas bden bzhi rtag mi rtag la sogs pa'i spros bral gyi rnam pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i

sgo nas theg chen gyi mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtag mi rtag la sogs pa'i sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba de lta bu'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bcu drug po de dag ni kun shes pa nyid 'chad pa'i skabs su dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam yin te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos mthong lam pa rnams kyis gong du bstan pa de las zlog pa rang don du myang 'das yid la byed pas bden bzhi mi rtag sogs bcu drug tu sgom pa sgom pa'i sgo nas so/ /nyan thos kyi mthong spang du gyur pa'i rtag pa la sogs pa gang zag gi bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa'i nyon mongs pa bcu drug spangs pa'i rnam pa can gyi mthong lam bzod shes skad cig ma bcu drug po ni kun shes 'chad pa'i skabs su shugs la bstan pa'i nyan thos kyi mthong lam yin te/'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam ma skyes gong gi nyan thos 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma bcu drug dang sgro 'dogs sogs gnyis dang bcu drug so sor sbyor mdzod/ drug pa ni/ byams pa mgon pos gzhi shes 'chad pa'i skabs gsum pa 'dir byang sems chen po rnams la sgom lam rtsa tshig gis zin par dngos su ma bstan to/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/ theg chen gyi sgom lam skabs gnyis par rgyas par

༄tsho/ /bstan zin pa la dgongs/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas mngon du mi byed pa la dgongs nas so/ /'o na nyan thos kyi mthong lam ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas shes par bya ba yin pas so/ /ngag don/ byams pa mgon po chos can/ nyid kyis skabs gsum pa 'dir byang sems chen po rnams la sgom lam rtsa tshig gis dngos su zin bar ma bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyid kyis theg chen gyi sgom lam skabs gnyis par rgyas par bstan zin pa la dgongs/ nyan thos kyi lam byang chub sems dpas mngon du mi byed pa la dgongs nas 'dir de ltar ma bstan pa'i phyir / chos can/ nyid kyis skabs gsum pa 'dir nyan thos kyi mthong lam dngos su bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nyan thos kyi lam byang chub sems dpas shes bya yin pa la dgongs nas 'dir de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar boni/ shes bya chos can/ sngar bstan pa de ltar mkhyen gsum rgyas par bstan nas de'i rjes su mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rgyas par bshad pa don bsdu ba'i sgo nas shes dgos pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ khyod la mjug bsdu bstan pa la rgyu mtshan

yod de/ khyod kyis mngon par rtogs pa'i don mtha' dag sdud par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bstan pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa ni/ rab 'byor/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag /spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsum gyi brjod bya rnam pa gsum po rdzogs par bstan pa yin no/ /gang gis na/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang po gsum gyi gzhung gis so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di dang /yang bstan pa'i lam shes pa nyid 'di dang / yang bstan pa'i thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ste/ mkhyen gsum rdzogs par bstan pa de ltar na ste de'i phyir ro/ /ngag don ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi skabs dang po gsum gyi gzhung tshig chos can/ rab 'byor dang mtha' gnyis rnam dag dang spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsum gyi brjod bya rnam pa gsum rdzogs par bstan pa yin te/ mkhyen pa gsum rdzogs par bstan pa'i phyir / rnam mkhyen dang lam shes la nye tshig sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ bshad ma thag pa thams cad shes pa nyid dang nye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de'i tshul te de dang 'dra bar bstan to// //bzhi pa ni/ mdor na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcosatsho mngon byer rtogs pa'i rgyan las thams cad shes pa nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i skabs gsum pa'i 'grel pa don gsal ba'i snying po gsal byed re zhig rdzogs so// //

༄༅/ /de ltar skabs gsum pas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad shes pa nyid kyi bdag nyid rdzogs par bstan nas/ da ni rgyu sbyor ba ston pa la bzhi las/ dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la/ rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bshad par bzhed do/ /gang na/ yul mkhyen gsum bshad nas de'i rjes su rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'o/ /gang gi sgo nas na/ rnam pa sbyor ba bcas rnams dang / /zhes sogs kyi bsdus don lus rnam gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa rgyas par bshad pa'i sgo nas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam byas shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du gzhi lam rnam pa thams cad shes pa'i don bsdus nas sgom par byed pas so/ /des na mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du de nyid bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /ngag don/ shes bya chos can/ yul mkhyen gsum bshad nas de'i rjes su rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ byang sems chen po rnams mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du gzhi lam rnam pa thams cad

shes pa nyid bsdus nas sgom par byed pas so/ /byang sems tshogs lam pa'i ting nge 'dzin chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi gnas lugs thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir du de nyid bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /des na rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/ de thob par byed pa'i sbyor ba la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa yin no/ /yang gi don ni gzhi lam rnam pa thos bsam gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir yul du byed par ma zad/ shes pa dbang du bya ba'i phyir yang bsgom zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rnam kun sbyor ba tsam gyi sgom rim dang / khyad par can gyi sgom rim gnyis/ dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sgom pa po gang zag /sgom sbyor ba/ thob bya yon tan/ dor bya skyon/ blang bya mtshan nyid/ rgyu thar pa cha mthun dang bdun/ dang po la mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba de yang rnam pa dang la sogs pa sbyor ba dang yon tan dang skyon dang mtshan nyid dang thar pa cha mthun dang nges

༄tsho/ /'byed cha mthun dang phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs dang srid zhi mnyam nyid dang zhing dag pa dang thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu gcig yin pas de rnams kyi nang nas dang por rnam pa bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam pa gtan la phab nas sbyor ba sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ tshig don 'byed pa la ngo bo dang / dbye ba mdor bstan gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi ni chos can bden pa bzhi yin la de'i bye brag mi mthun phyogs bden bzhi rtag sogs su 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par dmigs pa'i shes pa rnams shes pa'i rnam pa'i mtshan nyid du rnam par bzhag go /ngag don ni/ bden bzhi chos can/ gzhi yin te/ rang gi khyad par gyi chos kyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ chos can yin te/ rang gi khyad par gyi chos du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i chos mi rtag sogs bcu drug mtshan gzhi/rnam par mtshon/ khyad par gyi chos yin pa mtshan nyid do/ /byang sems mthong lam pa'i ye shes mtshan gzhi/ 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i shes rnam du mtshon/ bzhi bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs par dmigs pa'i shes pa mtshan nyid do/ /bden bzhi rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa'i shes pa chos can/ rang gi gnyen po bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi mi mthun phyogs yin te/ de'i spang bya yin

pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi mi rtag pa la sogs par dmigs pa'i bar chad med lam du gyur pa'i ye shes chos can/ rang gi spang bya bden bzhi rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs yin te/ de 'joms nus pa'i phyir/ chos can/ khyod de'i gnyen po'i phyogs/ de khyod kyi mi mthun phyogs yin pa 'thad de/ de ltar yin pa de rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de dag kyang sdud byed thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam pa gsum yod pa'i bye brag gis des bsdus pa'i gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de ni rnam pa gsum kho nar bzhed do/ /ngag don/ gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam de ni chos can/ gzhi shes dang / lam shes dang / rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus pa'i shes rnam rnam pa gsum kho nar nges te/ sdud byed mkhyen pa gsum kho nar nges pa'i phyir/kyang gi don ni/ gnyen po'i phyogs su gyur pa'i shes rnam gyi ngo bo mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas phye bar ma zad/ de'i dbye ba de dag kyang mkhyen pa gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsum du bzhag go zhes pa'o/ /'o na mkhyen gsum gyis bsdus pa'i rnam pa gsum po gang yin zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes kyi rnam pa ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di la

༄tsho/ /mtshams sbyar ba ni/ shes bya chos can/ rnam pa rnams mkhyen gsum gyis spyir te thun mong du bstan nas/ de'i rjes su khyad par du so sor phye nas bstan pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ mkhyen gsum so so'i rnam pa rnams so sor shes dgos pa'i phyir/ tshog don 'byed pa la bsdus te bstan pa dang / phye ste bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ yum 'di ni med pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o zhes pa nas rab 'byor cho8 kyi dbyings gnas pa nyid kyi phyir ro zhes pa'i bar gyi mdo tshig chos can/ khyod kyis gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad de/ khyod kyis med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa'i bar nyer bdun po de ni bden pa dang po gsum po re re la bzhi bzhi dang / lam bden la bco lnga bshad pa'i phyir/ de rnams gang zhe na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis ni/ gang du rnam pa gsum du phye ba de la de'i nang nas thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dbang du byas nas/ mdo las rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gsungs pa'i dang po bcu gnyis dang / bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis rang bzhin dang rang bzhin can du go rim bzhin du sbyar te bstan pa la/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos rtag pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i rnam par de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid de rang bzhin yin te/

'dus byas rnams skad cig re re la skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos rtag pa'i rang bzhin med pa'i rnam pa de chos can/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa yin te/ de'i khyad par gyi chos yin pa'i phyir/ des phyi ma rnams rigs 'gre'o/ /sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos de kho nar mi skye ba'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin te/ zag bcas rnams de kho nar skye 'jig dang bral ba'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos don gzhan gyi bdag gis dben pa'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos stong pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ stong pa ni dben pa'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdzi ba'i rnam pa de sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos bdag med pa'i rang bzhin yin te/ chos thams cad ni ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag gis mi brdzi ba'i ngo bo can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sogs pa kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par rang 'bras phung po lnga skye ba'i gnas med pa dang don dam par nam mkha' ltar skye 'gag med pa'i rnam brda kun 'byung bden pa'i chos rgyu dang / kun 'byung ba'i rang bzhin yin te/ rgyu dang kun 'byung ba'i chos rnams ni de kho nar gnas dang skye 'gag dang bral ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ kun 'byung bden pa'i chos don dam par yid kyi
